sentences.zh: }}麒麟者，仁獸也。

translations.literal: The qilin is a benevolent beast.
translations.idiomatic: The qilin is a beast of benevolence.

sentences.zh: 牡曰麒，牝曰麟。

translations.literal: The male is called qi; the female is called lin.
translations.idiomatic: The male is called qi and the female lin.

sentences.zh: 不刳胎剖卵則至。

translations.literal: When wombs are not cut open nor eggs split, it comes.
translations.idiomatic: It appears when no fetus is cut from the womb and no egg is broken open.

sentences.zh: 麕身而牛尾，狼項而一角，黃色而馬足。

translations.literal: A muntjac body with an ox tail, a wolf neck and a single horn, yellow in color with horse hooves.
translations.idiomatic: Its body is like a muntjac, its tail like an ox, its neck like a wolf, with a single horn, yellow in hue and hooves like a horse.

sentences.zh: 含仁而戴義，音中鍾呂，步中規矩，不踐生蟲，不折生草，不食不義，不飲洿池，不入坑穽，不行羅網。

translations.literal: It embodies benevolence and bears righteousness upon its head; its voice matches the zhong and lü pitches, its gait matches compass and square; it does not tread on living insects, does not break living grass, does not eat what is unrighteous, does not drink from foul pools, does not enter pits and traps, does not walk into nets.
translations.idiomatic: It carries benevolence within and righteousness upon its brow; its cry accords with the bell and pitch pipes, its steps with compass and rule. It will not tread on living insects, break living plants, eat what is unjust, drink from foul waters, enter pits or traps, or pass through snares.

sentences.zh: 明王動靜有儀則見。

translations.literal: When an enlightened king moves and rests with proper ritual, it appears.
translations.idiomatic: It appears when an enlightened sovereign conducts himself with due ceremony in motion and repose.

sentences.zh: 牡鳴曰逝聖，牝鳴曰歸和，春鳴曰扶幼，夏鳴曰養綏。

translations.literal: The male cry is called "departing sage"; the female cry "returning harmony"; the spring cry "supporting the young"; the summer cry "nurturing peace."
translations.idiomatic: When the male calls, the name is "Departing Sage"; when the female calls, "Returning Harmony"; in spring, "Supporting the Young"; in summer, "Nurturing Tranquility."

sentences.zh: 漢武帝元狩元年十年，行幸雍，祠五畤，獲白麟。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Emperor Wu of Han's Yuanning reign, he traveled to Yong, sacrificed at the Five Altars, and obtained a white qilin.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the first year of the Yuanning era under Emperor Wu of Han, the emperor visited Yong, offered sacrifice at the Five Altars, and captured a white qilin.

sentences.zh: 漢武帝太始二年三月，獲白麟。

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year of the Taishi reign of Emperor Wu of Han, a white qilin was obtained.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year of the Taishi era, a white qilin was captured.

sentences.zh: 漢章帝元和二年以來，至章和元年，凡三年，麒麟五十一見郡國。

translations.literal: From the second year of the Yuanhe reign of Emperor Zhang of Han through the first year of Zhanghe, in all three years qilins were seen fifty-one times in the commanderies and kingdoms.
translations.idiomatic: From the second year of Yuanhe under Emperor Zhang of Han until the first year of Zhanghe — three years in all — qilins were reported fifty-one times across the commanderies and kingdoms.

sentences.zh: 漢安帝延光三年七月，麒麟見潁川陽翟。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year of the Yan'guang reign of Emperor An of Han, a qilin appeared at Yangzhai in Yingchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year of Yan'guang, Emperor An of Han, a qilin appeared at Yangzhai in Yingchuan.

sentences.zh: 延光三年八月戊子，麒麟見潁川陽翟。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi of the eighth month of the third year of Yan'guang, a qilin appeared at Yangzhai in Yingchuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the eighth month in the third year of Yan'guang, a qilin appeared at Yangzhai in Yingchuan.

sentences.zh: 延光四年正月壬午，麒麟見東郡濮陽。

translations.literal: On the day renwu of the first month of the fourth year of Yan'guang, a qilin appeared at Puyang in Dong Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the first month in the fourth year of Yan'guang, a qilin appeared at Puyang in Dong Commandery.

sentences.zh: 漢獻帝延康元年，麒麟十見郡國。

translations.literal: In the first year of the Yankang reign of Emperor Xian of Han, qilins were seen ten times in the commanderies and kingdoms.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yankang under Emperor Xian of Han, qilins were reported ten times across the commanderies and kingdoms.

sentences.zh: 吳孫權赤烏元年八月，武昌言麒麟見。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of the Chiwu reign of Sun Quan of Wu, Wuchang reported that a qilin had appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of Chiwu, Sun Quan of Wu, Wuchang reported a qilin sighting.

sentences.zh: 又白麟見建業。

translations.literal: Again a white qilin appeared at Jianye.
translations.idiomatic: A white qilin also appeared at Jianye.

sentences.zh: 晉武帝泰始元年十二月，麒麟見南郡枝江。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of the Taishi reign of Emperor Wu of Jin, a qilin appeared at Zhijiang in Nan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the first year of Taishi, Emperor Wu of Jin, a qilin appeared at Zhijiang in Nan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 晉武帝咸寧五年二月甲午，白麟見平原鬲縣。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu of the second month of the fifth year of the Xianning reign of Emperor Wu of Jin, a white qilin appeared at Ge County in Pingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the second month in the fifth year of Xianning, a white qilin appeared at Ge County in Pingyuan.

sentences.zh: 咸寧五年九月甲午，麒麟見河南陽城。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu of the ninth month of the fifth year of Xianning, a qilin appeared at Yangcheng in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the ninth month in the fifth year of Xianning, a qilin appeared at Yangcheng in Henan.

sentences.zh: 晉武帝太康元年四月，白麟見頓丘。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of the Taikang reign of Emperor Wu of Jin, a white qilin appeared at Dunqiu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of Taikang, a white qilin appeared at Dunqiu.

sentences.zh: 晉愍帝建興二年九月丙戌，麒麟見襄平，州刺史崔毖以聞。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu of the ninth month of the second year of the Jianxing reign of Emperor Min of Jin, a qilin appeared at Xiangping; Inspector Cui Bi reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day of the ninth month in the second year of Jianxing, a qilin appeared at Xiangping, and the provincial inspector Cui Bi reported it.

sentences.zh: 晉元帝太興元年正月戊子，麒麟見豫章。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi of the first month of the first year of the Taixing reign of Emperor Yuan of Jin, a qilin appeared at Yuzhang.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the first month in the first year of Taixing, a qilin appeared at Yuzhang.

sentences.zh: 晉成帝咸和八年五月己巳，麒麟見遼東。

translations.literal: On the day jisi of the fifth month of the eighth year of the Xianhe reign of Emperor Cheng of Jin, a qilin appeared in Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the fifth month in the eighth year of Xianhe, a qilin appeared in Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 鳳凰者，仁鳥也。

translations.literal: The phoenix is a benevolent bird.
translations.idiomatic: The phoenix is a bird of benevolence.

sentences.zh: 不刳胎剖卵則至。

translations.literal: When wombs are not cut open nor eggs split, it comes.
translations.idiomatic: It appears when no fetus is cut from the womb and no egg is broken open.

sentences.zh: 或翔或集。

translations.literal: At times it soars, at times it alights.
translations.idiomatic: Now it flies, now it perches.

sentences.zh: 雄曰鳳，雌曰凰。

translations.literal: The male is called feng; the female is called huang.
translations.idiomatic: The male is called feng and the female huang.

sentences.zh: 蛇頭燕頷，龜背鼈腹，鶴頸鷄喙，鴻前魚尾，青首駢翼，鷺立而鴛鴦思。

translations.literal: A serpent head and swallow jaw, tortoise back and turtle belly, crane neck and cock beak, swan breast and fish tail, blue head and paired wings, standing like an egret yet with the mien of a mandarin duck.
translations.idiomatic: Its head is like a serpent, its jaw like a swallow, its back like a tortoise, its belly like a turtle, its neck like a crane, its beak like a cock, its breast like a swan, its tail like a fish, its head green and its wings paired; it stands like an egret yet bears the grace of a mandarin duck.

sentences.zh: 首戴德而背負仁，項荷義而膺抱信，足履正而尾繫武。

translations.literal: Its head bears virtue upon it, its back carries benevolence, its neck shoulders righteousness, its breast embraces trustworthiness, its feet tread what is upright and its tail is bound to martial prowess.
translations.idiomatic: Virtue crowns its head, benevolence rests upon its back, righteousness loads its neck, trustworthiness fills its breast, its feet walk in rectitude and its tail is tied to martial virtue.

sentences.zh: 小音中鍾，大音中鼓。

translations.literal: In small voice it matches the bell; in great voice it matches the drum.
translations.idiomatic: Its soft notes accord with the bell, its full notes with the drum.

sentences.zh: 延頸奮翼，五光備舉。

translations.literal: It extends its neck and flaps its wings; the five colors are all displayed.
translations.idiomatic: Stretching its neck and beating its wings, it displays all five colors.

sentences.zh: 興八風，降時雨，食有節，飲有儀，往有文，來有嘉，遊必擇地，飲不妄下。

translations.literal: It stirs the eight winds and sends down timely rain; in eating it has measure, in drinking it has ritual; in going forth it has pattern, in coming it has blessing; in roaming it must choose its ground, and it does not drink at random.
translations.idiomatic: It raises the eight winds and brings timely rain; it eats with restraint and drinks with ceremony; its departure has ornament, its arrival brings blessing; it roams only where the ground is fit and never drinks heedlessly.

sentences.zh: 其鳴，雄曰「節節」，雌曰「足足」。

translations.literal: In its cries the male says "jie jie," the female says "zu zu."
translations.idiomatic: In its call the male cries "jie jie" and the female "zu zu."

sentences.zh: 晨鳴曰發明，晝鳴曰上朔，夕鳴曰歸昌，昏鳴曰固常，夜鳴曰保長。

translations.literal: The morning cry is called "bringing forth light"; the daytime cry "ascending the new moon"; the evening cry "returning splendor"; the dusk cry "securing constancy"; the night cry "guarding growth."
translations.idiomatic: At dawn it cries "Bringing Forth Light"; by day, "Ascending the New"; at evening, "Returning Splendor"; at dusk, "Securing Constancy"; at night, "Guarding Growth."

sentences.zh: 其樂也，徘徘徊徊，雍雍喈喈。

translations.literal: In its music it moves to and fro, harmonious and melodious.
translations.idiomatic: In its song it wheels and turns, rich and resonant.

sentences.zh: 唯鳳皇為能究萬物，通天祉，象百狀，達王道，率五音，成九德，備文武，正下國。

translations.literal: Only the phoenix can exhaust the myriad things, penetrate Heaven's blessings, image the hundred forms, reach the kingly Way, lead the five tones, complete the nine virtues, embody wen and wu, and rectify the subordinate states.
translations.idiomatic: Only the phoenix can comprehend the myriad creatures, receive Heaven's blessings, embody the hundred forms, attain the kingly Way, govern the five tones, fulfill the nine virtues, unite civil and martial excellence, and set the lesser realms in order.

sentences.zh: 故得鳳之象，一則過之，二則翔之，三則集之，四則春秋居之，五則終身居之。

translations.literal: Therefore when one obtains the phoenix's likeness: once it passes by; twice it soars; thrice it alights; four times it dwells spring and autumn; five times it dwells for a lifetime.
translations.idiomatic: Hence when the phoenix's image is attained: the first time it passes by; the second it soars; the third it alights; the fourth it stays through spring and autumn; the fifth it remains for life.

sentences.zh: 漢昭帝始元三年十月，鳳皇集東海，遣使祠其處。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the third year of the Shiyuan reign of Emperor Zhao of Han, the phoenix gathered in Donghai; an envoy was sent to sacrifice at the place.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the third year of Shiyuan, Emperor Zhao of Han, phoenixes gathered in Donghai, and an envoy was dispatched to offer sacrifice at the site.

sentences.zh: 漢宣帝本始元年五月，鳳皇集膠東。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of the Benshi reign of Emperor Xuan of Han, the phoenix gathered in Jiaodong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of Benshi, phoenixes gathered in Jiaodong.

sentences.zh: 本始四年五月，鳳皇集北海。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fourth year of Benshi, the phoenix gathered in Beihai.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fourth year of Benshi, phoenixes gathered in Beihai.

sentences.zh: 漢宣帝地節二年四月，鳳皇集魯，羣鳥從之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year of the Dijie reign of Emperor Xuan of Han, the phoenix gathered in Lu, and flocks of birds followed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year of Dijie, phoenixes gathered in Lu, with multitudes of birds following them.

sentences.zh: 漢宣帝元康元年三月，鳳皇集泰山、陳留。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of the Yuankang reign of Emperor Xuan of Han, the phoenix gathered on Mount Tai and at Chenliu.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the first year of Yuankang, phoenixes gathered on Mount Tai and at Chenliu.

sentences.zh: 元康四年，南郡獲威鳳。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yuankang, Nan Commandery obtained a mighty phoenix.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Yuankang, Nan Commandery captured a mighty phoenix.

sentences.zh: 漢宣帝神雀二年二月，鳳皇集京師，羣鳥從之以萬數。

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year of the Shenque reign of Emperor Xuan of Han, the phoenix gathered in the capital; flocks of birds followed in tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the second year of Shenque, phoenixes gathered in the capital, and birds followed in their tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 神雀四年春，鳳皇集京師。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year of Shenque, the phoenix gathered in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year of Shenque, phoenixes gathered in the capital.

sentences.zh: 神雀四年十月，鳳皇十一集杜陵。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fourth year of Shenque, eleven phoenixes gathered at Duling.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fourth year of Shenque, eleven phoenixes gathered at Duling.

sentences.zh: 神雀四年十二月，鳳皇集上林。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the fourth year of Shenque, the phoenix gathered in Shanglin Park.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the fourth year of Shenque, phoenixes gathered in Shanglin Park.

sentences.zh: 漢宣帝甘露三年二月，鳳皇集新蔡，羣鳥四面行列，皆向鳳皇立，以萬數。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year of the Ganlu reign of Emperor Xuan of Han, the phoenix gathered in Xincai; birds on all four sides formed ranks, all facing the phoenix and standing, numbering in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year of Ganlu, phoenixes gathered at Xincai; birds arrayed on every side, all turned toward the phoenix and stood, numbering in the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 漢光武建武十七年十月，鳳皇五，高八九尺，毛羽五采，集潁川郡，羣鳥並從行列，蓋地數頃，留十七日乃去。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the seventeenth year of the Jianwu reign of Emperor Guangwu of Han, five phoenixes, eight or nine chi tall, with feathers of five colors, gathered in Yingchuan Commandery; birds all followed in ranks covering several qing of ground; they remained seventeen days before departing.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the seventeenth year of Jianwu, five phoenixes eight or nine chi in height, their plumage in five colors, gathered in Yingchuan Commandery; birds followed in procession covering several qing; they stayed seventeen days and then left.

sentences.zh: 漢章帝元和二年以來，至章和元年，凡三年，鳳皇百三十九見郡國。

translations.literal: From the second year of the Yuanhe reign of Emperor Zhang of Han through the first year of Zhanghe, in all three years phoenixes were seen one hundred thirty-nine times in the commanderies and kingdoms.
translations.idiomatic: From the second year of Yuanhe under Emperor Zhang through the first year of Zhanghe — three years in all — phoenixes were reported one hundred thirty-nine times across the commanderies and kingdoms.

sentences.zh: 漢安帝延光三年二月，車駕東巡。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year of the Yan'guang reign of Emperor An of Han, the imperial carriage made an eastern tour.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year of Yan'guang, Emperor An of Han, the emperor traveled east on inspection.

sentences.zh: 其月戊子，鳳皇集濟南臺縣丞霍收舍樹上，賜臺長嶷帛十五匹，收二十匹，尉半之，吏卒人三匹；

translations.literal: That month on the day wuzi, a phoenix gathered on a tree at the house of Assistant Magistrate Huo Shou of Tai County in Jinan; the magistrate of Tai, Ni, was granted fifteen bolts of silk, Shou twenty bolts, the commandant half that amount, and clerks and soldiers three bolts each;
translations.idiomatic: That month on the wuzi day, a phoenix alighted on a tree at the home of Assistant Magistrate Huo Shou of Tai County in Jinan. Magistrate Ni received fifteen bolts of silk, Shou twenty bolts, the commandant half as much, and clerks and soldiers three bolts each;

sentences.zh: 鳳皇所過亭部，無出今年田租；

translations.literal: in the districts and stations the phoenix passed, no field tax was levied for that year;
translations.idiomatic: in every district and post station the phoenix had passed, the year's field tax was remitted;

sentences.zh: 賜男子爵人二級。

translations.literal: and common men were granted two ranks of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: and common men were raised two degrees in noble rank.

sentences.zh: 延光三年十月壬午，鳳皇集京兆新豐西界槐樹。

translations.literal: On the day renwu of the tenth month of the third year of Yan'guang, a phoenix gathered on a locust tree on the western border of Xinfeng in Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the tenth month in the third year of Yan'guang, a phoenix gathered on a locust tree on the western border of Xinfeng in Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 漢桓帝建和元年十一月，鳳皇見濟陰己氏。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the first year of the Jianhe reign of Emperor Huan of Han, a phoenix appeared at Jishi in Jiyin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the first year of Jianhe, a phoenix appeared at Jishi in Jiyin.

sentences.zh: 漢靈帝光和四年秋，五色大鳥見新城，羣鳥隨之。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the fourth year of the Guanghe reign of Emperor Ling of Han, a great bird of five colors appeared in Xincheng, and flocks of birds followed.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the fourth year of Guanghe, a great bird in five colors appeared at Xincheng, with flocks of birds following.

sentences.zh: 民皆謂之鳳皇。

translations.literal: The people all called it a phoenix.
translations.idiomatic: The common people all took it for a phoenix.

sentences.zh: 漢獻帝延康元年八月，石邑縣言鳳皇集。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of the Yankang reign of Emperor Xian of Han, Shiyi County reported that a phoenix had gathered.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of Yankang, Shiyi County reported that phoenixes had gathered.

sentences.zh: 又郡國十三言鳳皇見。

translations.literal: Again thirteen commanderies and kingdoms reported phoenix sightings.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen more commanderies and kingdoms also reported phoenix appearances.

sentences.zh: 吳孫權黃武五年七月，蒼梧言鳳皇見。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fifth year of the Huangwu reign of Sun Quan of Wu, Cangwu reported that a phoenix had appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifth year of Huangwu, Cangwu reported a phoenix sighting.

sentences.zh: 孫權黃龍元年四月，夏口、武昌並言鳳皇見。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of the Huanglong reign of Sun Quan, both Xiakou and Wuchang reported phoenix appearances.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of Huanglong, both Xiakou and Wuchang reported phoenix appearances.

sentences.zh: 吳孫亮建興二年十一月，大鳥五見于春申。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the second year of the Jianxing reign of Sun Liang of Wu, five great birds appeared at Chunshen.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the second year of Jianxing, Sun Liang of Wu, five great birds appeared at Chunshen.

sentences.zh: 吳孫晧建衡四年正月，西苑言鳳皇集。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year of the Jianheng reign of Sun Hao of Wu, the Western Park reported that a phoenix had gathered.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year of Jianheng, the Western Park reported that phoenixes had gathered.

sentences.zh: 晉武帝泰始元年十二月，鳳皇見上黨高都。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of the Taishi reign of Emperor Wu of Jin, a phoenix appeared at Gaodu in Shangdang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the first year of Taishi, a phoenix appeared at Gaodu in Shangdang.

sentences.zh: 泰始元年十二月，鳳皇二見河南山陽。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of Taishi, phoenixes appeared twice in Shanyang in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the first year of Taishi, phoenixes appeared twice in Shanyang, Henan.

sentences.zh: 泰始元年十二月，鳳皇三見馮翊下邽。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of Taishi, phoenixes appeared three times at Xiapi in Fengyi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the first year of Taishi, phoenixes appeared three times at Xiapi in Fengyi.

sentences.zh: 晉穆帝升平四年二月辛亥，鳳皇將九子見鄖鄉之豐城。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai of the second month of the fourth year of the Shengping reign of Emperor Mu of Jin, a phoenix leading nine young appeared at Fengcheng in Yuxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the second month in the fourth year of Shengping, a phoenix with nine fledglings appeared at Fengcheng in Yuxiang.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子，又見豐城，眾鳥隨從。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi of the twelfth month, it appeared again at Fengcheng, and many birds followed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day of the twelfth month it appeared again at Fengcheng, with multitudes of birds following.

sentences.zh: 升平五年四月己未，鳳皇集沔北，至于辛酉。

translations.literal: From the day jiwei of the fourth month of the fifth year of Shengping, a phoenix gathered north of the Mian, remaining until the day xinyou.
translations.idiomatic: From the jiwei day of the fourth month in the fifth year of Shengping, a phoenix gathered north of the Mian River until the xinyou day.

sentences.zh: 百姓聚觀之。

translations.literal: The common people gathered to watch.
translations.idiomatic: The people assembled to gaze upon it.

sentences.zh: 宋武帝永初元年七月戊戌，鳳皇見會稽山陰。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu of the seventh month of the first year of the Yongchu reign of Emperor Wu of Song, a phoenix appeared at Shanyin in Kuaiji.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the seventh month in the first year of Yongchu, a phoenix appeared at Shanyin in Kuaiji.

sentences.zh: 文帝元嘉十四年三月丙申，大鳥二集秣陵民王顗園中李樹上，大如孔雀，頭足小高，毛羽鮮明，文采五色，聲音諧從，眾鳥如山雞者隨之，如行三十步頃，東南飛去。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen of the third month of the fourteenth year of the Yuanjia reign of Emperor Wen, two great birds gathered on a plum tree in the garden of the commoner Wang Yan of Moling; they were as large as peacocks, with head and legs somewhat elevated, bright plumage and five-colored pattern; their voices harmonized; birds like pheasants followed; after about thirty paces they flew off toward the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the third month in the fourteenth year of Yuanjia, two great birds alighted on a plum tree in the garden of Wang Yan, a resident of Moling. They were the size of peacocks, with head and legs somewhat raised, brilliant feathers in five colors, and harmonious cries; birds like pheasants followed them; after some thirty paces they flew away toward the southeast.

sentences.zh: 揚州刺史彭城王義康以聞。

translations.literal: The Inspector of Yang Province, the Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, reported it.
translations.idiomatic: Yikang, Prince of Pengcheng and inspector of Yang Province, reported the event.

sentences.zh: 改鳥所集永昌里曰鳳皇里。

translations.literal: The lane where the birds had gathered, Yongchang Lane, was renamed Phoenix Lane.
translations.idiomatic: The lane where the birds had settled, Yongchang Lane, was renamed Phoenix Lane.

sentences.zh: 孝武帝孝建元年正月庚申，鳳皇見丹徒愒賢亭，雙鵠為引，眾鳥陪從。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen of the first month of the first year of the Xiaojian reign of Emperor Xiaowu, a phoenix appeared at Xiexian Pavilion in Dantu; a pair of swans led the way, and many birds attended.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the first month in the first year of Xiaojian, a phoenix appeared at Xiexian Pavilion in Dantu, led by a pair of swans with many birds in attendance.

sentences.zh: 征虜將軍武昌王渾以聞。

translations.literal: Hun, Prince of Wuchang and General Who Conquers the Barbarians, reported it.
translations.idiomatic: Hun, Prince of Wuchang and General Who Conquers the Barbarians, reported it.

sentences.zh: 神鳥者，赤神之精也，知音聲清濁和調者也。

translations.literal: The divine bird is the essence of the Red Spirit; it knows whether sounds are clear or muddy and whether they are harmonized.
translations.idiomatic: The divine bird is the essence of the Red Spirit; it discerns whether tones are clear or dull and whether they are in harmony.

sentences.zh: 雖赤色而備五采，雞身，鳴中五音，肅肅雍雍。

translations.literal: Though red in color it bears all five hues; its body is like a cock; its cry matches the five tones; solemn and harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: Though red, it displays all five colors; its body is like a cock; its call accords with the five tones, solemn and harmonious.

sentences.zh: 喜則鳴舞，樂處幽隱。

translations.literal: When pleased it cries and dances; it delights in secluded places.
translations.idiomatic: When joyful it sings and dances; it loves hidden retreats.

sentences.zh: 風俗從則至。

translations.literal: When customs follow the Way, it comes.
translations.idiomatic: It appears when popular customs accord with the Way.

sentences.zh: 漢宣帝五鳳三年三月辛丑，神鳥集長樂宮東闕樹上，又飛下地，五采炳發，留十餘刻。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou of the third month of the third year of the Wufeng reign of Emperor Xuan of Han, a divine bird gathered on a tree at the east gate-tower of Changle Palace; it also flew to the ground; the five colors blazed forth; it remained more than ten quarters of an hour.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the third month in the third year of Wufeng, a divine bird gathered on a tree at the east gate of Changle Palace, then flew to the ground; the five colors flamed bright; it stayed more than ten quarters of an hour.

sentences.zh: 漢章帝元和中，神鳥見郡國。

translations.literal: During the Yuanhe era of Emperor Zhang of Han, divine birds appeared in the commanderies and kingdoms.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yuanhe era under Emperor Zhang of Han, divine birds appeared across the commanderies and kingdoms.

sentences.zh: 黃龍者，四龍之長也。

translations.literal: The yellow dragon is the eldest of the four dragons.
translations.idiomatic: The yellow dragon is chief among the four dragons.

sentences.zh: 不漉池而漁，德至淵泉，則黃龍游於池。

translations.literal: When one does not drain pools to fish, and virtue reaches the deep springs, the yellow dragon swims in the pool.
translations.idiomatic: When pools are not drained for fishing and virtue penetrates to the deepest springs, the yellow dragon swims in the waters.

sentences.zh: 能高能下，能細能大，能幽能冥，能短能長，乍存乍亡。

translations.literal: It can be high or low, fine or great, hidden or obscure, short or long; now present, now gone.
translations.idiomatic: It can rise high or sink low, grow fine or great, hide in shadow or vanish into darkness, shorten or lengthen, appear and disappear in an instant.

sentences.zh: 赤龍、河圖者，地之符也。

translations.literal: The red dragon and the River Chart are tokens of the earth.
translations.idiomatic: The red dragon and the River Chart are earthly portents.

sentences.zh: 王者德至淵泉，則河出龍圖。

translations.literal: When a king's virtue reaches the deep springs, the river yields the dragon chart.
translations.idiomatic: When a sovereign's virtue reaches the deepest springs, the river brings forth the dragon chart.

sentences.zh: 漢惠帝二年正月癸酉，兩龍見蘭陵人家井中。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou of the first month of the second year of Emperor Hui of Han, two dragons appeared in a well at a house in Lanling.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the first month in the second year of Emperor Hui of Han, two dragons appeared in a well at a home in Lanling.

sentences.zh: 漢文帝十五年春，黃龍見成紀。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifteenth year of Emperor Wen of Han, a yellow dragon appeared at Chengji.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fifteenth year of his reign, Emperor Wen of Han, a yellow dragon appeared at Chengji.

sentences.zh: 漢宣帝甘露元年四月，黃龍見新豐。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of the Ganlu reign of Emperor Xuan of Han, a yellow dragon appeared at Xinfeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of Ganlu, a yellow dragon appeared at Xinfeng.

sentences.zh: 漢成帝鴻嘉元年冬，黃龍見真定。

translations.literal: In the winter of the first year of the Hongjia reign of Emperor Cheng of Han, a yellow dragon appeared at Zhending.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the first year of Hongjia, a yellow dragon appeared at Zhending.

sentences.zh: 漢成帝永始二年二月癸未，黃龍見東萊。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei of the second month of the second year of the Yongshi reign of Emperor Cheng of Han, a yellow dragon appeared in Donglai.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day of the second month in the second year of Yongshi, a yellow dragon appeared in Donglai.

sentences.zh: 漢光武建武十二年六月，黃龍見東阿。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twelfth year of the Jianwu reign of Emperor Guangwu of Han, a yellow dragon appeared in Dong'a.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twelfth year of Jianwu, a yellow dragon appeared in Dong'a.

sentences.zh: 漢章帝元和二年以來，至章和元年，凡三年，黃龍四十四見郡國。

translations.literal: From the second year of the Yuanhe reign of Emperor Zhang of Han through the first year of Zhanghe, in all three years yellow dragons were seen forty-four times in the commanderies and kingdoms.
translations.idiomatic: From the second year of Yuanhe under Emperor Zhang through the first year of Zhanghe — three years in all — yellow dragons were reported forty-four times across the commanderies and kingdoms.

sentences.zh: 元和中，青龍見郡國。

translations.literal: During the Yuanhe era, blue dragons appeared in the commanderies and kingdoms.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yuanhe era, blue dragons appeared across the commanderies and kingdoms.

sentences.zh: 元和中，白龍見郡國。

translations.literal: During the Yuanhe era, white dragons appeared in the commanderies and kingdoms.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yuanhe era, white dragons appeared across the commanderies and kingdoms.

sentences.zh: 漢安帝延光元年八月辛卯，黃龍見九真。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao of the eighth month of the first year of the Yan'guang reign of Emperor An of Han, a yellow dragon appeared in Jiuzhen.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the eighth month in the first year of Yan'guang, a yellow dragon appeared in Jiuzhen.

sentences.zh: 延光三年九月辛亥，黃龍見濟南歷城。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai of the ninth month of the third year of Yan'guang, a yellow dragon appeared at Licheng in Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the ninth month in the third year of Yan'guang, a yellow dragon appeared at Licheng in Jinan.

sentences.zh: 延光三年十二月乙未，黃龍見琅邪諸縣。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei of the twelfth month of the third year of Yan'guang, a yellow dragon appeared in the counties of Langye.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day of the twelfth month in the third year of Yan'guang, a yellow dragon appeared in the counties of Langye.

sentences.zh: 延光四年正月壬午，黃龍二見東郡濮陽。

translations.literal: On the day renwu of the first month of the fourth year of Yan'guang, two yellow dragons appeared at Puyang in Dong Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the first month in the fourth year of Yan'guang, two yellow dragons appeared at Puyang in Dong Commandery.

sentences.zh: 漢桓帝建和元年二月，黃龍見沛國譙。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of the Jianhe reign of Emperor Huan of Han, a yellow dragon appeared at Qiao in Pei.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of Jianhe, a yellow dragon appeared at Qiao in Pei Commandery.

sentences.zh: 漢桓帝元嘉二年八月，黃龍見濟陰句陽，又見金城允街。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year of the Yuanjia reign of Emperor Huan of Han, a yellow dragon appeared at Juyang in Jiyin, and again at Yunjie in Jincheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year of Yuanjia, a yellow dragon appeared at Juyang in Jiyin and again at Yunjie in Jincheng.

sentences.zh: 漢桓帝永康元年八月，黃龍見巴郡。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of the Yongkang reign of Emperor Huan of Han, a yellow dragon appeared in Ba Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of Yongkang, a yellow dragon appeared in Ba Commandery.

sentences.zh: 漢獻帝延康元年三月，黃龍見譙。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of the Yankang reign of Emperor Xian of Han, a yellow dragon appeared at Qiao.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the first year of Yankang, a yellow dragon appeared at Qiao.

sentences.zh: 又郡國十三言黃龍見。

translations.literal: Again thirteen commanderies and kingdoms reported yellow dragon sightings.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen more commanderies and kingdoms also reported yellow dragons.

sentences.zh: 魏明帝青龍元年正月甲申，青龍見郟之摩陂井。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen of the first month of the first year of the Qinglong reign of Emperor Ming of Wei, a blue dragon appeared in the well at Mobei in Jia.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the first month in the first year of Qinglong, a blue dragon appeared in the well at Mobei in Jia.

sentences.zh: 帝親與羣臣共觀之，既而詔畫工圖寫，龍潛而不見。

translations.literal: The emperor personally viewed it together with his ministers; he then ordered painters to depict it, but the dragon submerged and was not seen.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor went in person with his ministers to observe it, then ordered artists to paint it, but the dragon sank from sight and could not be found.

sentences.zh: 魏明帝景初元年二月壬辰，山茌縣言黃龍見。

translations.literal: On the day renchen of the second month of the first year of the Jingchu reign of Emperor Ming of Wei, Shanzhi County reported a yellow dragon sighting.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day of the second month in the first year of Jingchu, Shanzhi County reported a yellow dragon.

sentences.zh: 魏少帝正元元年十月戊戌，黃龍見鄴井中。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu of the tenth month of the first year of the Zhengyuan reign of the Young Emperor of Wei, a yellow dragon appeared in a well at Ye.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the tenth month in the first year of Zhengyuan, a yellow dragon appeared in a well at Ye.

sentences.zh: 魏少帝甘露元年正月辛丑，青龍見軹縣井中凡二。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou of the first month of the first year of the Ganlu reign of the Young Emperor of Wei, blue dragons appeared in wells at Zhi County, two in all.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the first month in the first year of Ganlu, two blue dragons appeared in wells at Zhi County.

sentences.zh: 甘露元年六月，青龍見元城縣界井中。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Ganlu, a blue dragon appeared in a well on the border of Yuancheng County.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of Ganlu, a blue dragon appeared in a border well at Yuancheng County.

sentences.zh: 甘露二年二月，青龍見溫縣井中。

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year of Ganlu, a blue dragon appeared in a well at Wen County.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the second year of Ganlu, a blue dragon appeared in a well at Wen County.

sentences.zh: 甘露三年八月甲戌，黃龍、青龍仍見頓丘、冠軍、陽夏縣井中。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu of the eighth month of the third year of Ganlu, yellow and blue dragons appeared repeatedly in wells at Dunqiu, Guanjun, and Yangxia counties.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the eighth month in the third year of Ganlu, yellow and blue dragons were seen again and again in wells at Dunqiu, Guanjun, and Yangxia.

sentences.zh: 甘露四年正月，黃龍二見寧陵縣井中。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year of Ganlu, two yellow dragons appeared in wells at Ningling County.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year of Ganlu, two yellow dragons appeared in wells at Ningling County.

sentences.zh: 魏元帝景元元年十二月甲申，黃龍見莘縣井中。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen of the twelfth month of the first year of the Jingyuan reign of Emperor Yuan of Wei, a yellow dragon appeared in a well at Shen County.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the twelfth month in the first year of Jingyuan, a yellow dragon appeared in a well at Shen County.

sentences.zh: 景元三年二月，青龍見軹縣井中。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year of Jingyuan, a blue dragon appeared in a well at Zhi County.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year of Jingyuan, a blue dragon appeared in a well at Zhi County.

sentences.zh: 劉備未即位前，黃龍見武陽赤水，九日乃去。

translations.literal: Before Liu Bei took the throne, a yellow dragon appeared at Chishui in Wuyang and departed after nine days.
translations.idiomatic: Before Liu Bei assumed the throne, a yellow dragon appeared at Chishui in Wuyang and left after nine days.

sentences.zh: 吳孫權黃武元年三月，鄱陽言黃龍見。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of the Huangwu reign of Sun Quan of Wu, Poyang reported a yellow dragon sighting.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the first year of Huangwu, Poyang reported a yellow dragon.

sentences.zh: 吳孫權黃龍元年四月，夏口、武昌並言黃龍見。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of the Huanglong reign of Sun Quan of Wu, both Xiakou and Wuchang reported yellow dragon sightings.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of Huanglong, both Xiakou and Wuchang reported yellow dragons.

sentences.zh: 權因此改元。

translations.literal: Quan therefore changed his reign title.
translations.idiomatic: Quan accordingly changed his era name.

sentences.zh: 作黃龍牙，常在軍中，進退視其所向，命胡綜為賦。

translations.literal: He fashioned a yellow-dragon banner, kept it always in the army, advancing or retreating according to the direction it faced, and commissioned Hu Zong to compose a rhapsody.
translations.idiomatic: He made a Yellow Dragon standard, kept it always with the army, and marched according to the direction it pointed; he ordered Hu Zong to write a fu in its honor.

sentences.zh: 吳孫權赤烏五年三月，海鹽縣言黃龍見縣井中二。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fifth year of the Chiwu reign of Sun Quan of Wu, Haiyan County reported two yellow dragons in the county well.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fifth year of Chiwu, Haiyan County reported two yellow dragons in the county well.

sentences.zh: 赤烏十一年，雲陽言黃龍見。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Chiwu, Yunyang reported a yellow dragon sighting.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Chiwu, Yunyang reported a yellow dragon.

sentences.zh: 黃龍二又見武陵吳壽，光色炫燿。

translations.literal: Two yellow dragons again appeared at Wushou in Wuling, their light dazzling.
translations.idiomatic: Two yellow dragons appeared again at Wushou in Wuling, their radiance blazing bright.

sentences.zh: 吳孫休永安四年九月，布山言白龍見。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the fourth year of the Yong'an reign of Sun Xiu of Wu, Bushan reported a white dragon sighting.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the fourth year of Yong'an, Bushan reported a white dragon.

sentences.zh: 永安五年七月，始新言黃龍見。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fifth year of Yong'an, Shixin reported a yellow dragon sighting.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifth year of Yong'an, Shixin reported a yellow dragon.

sentences.zh: 永安六年四月，泉陵言黃龍見。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the sixth year of Yong'an, Quanling reported a yellow dragon sighting.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the sixth year of Yong'an, Quanling reported a yellow dragon.

sentences.zh: 晉武帝泰始元年十二月，青龍二見濟陰定陶。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of the Taishi reign of Emperor Wu of Jin, two blue dragons appeared at Dingtao in Jiyin.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the first year of Taishi, two blue dragons appeared at Dingtao in Jiyin.

sentences.zh: 泰始元年十二月，青龍見魏郡湯陰。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of Taishi, a blue dragon appeared at Tangyin in Wei Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the first year of Taishi, a blue dragon appeared at Tangyin in Wei Commandery.

sentences.zh: 泰始元年十二月，黃龍見河南洛陽洛濱。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of Taishi, a yellow dragon appeared on the banks of the Luo at Luoyang in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the first year of Taishi, a yellow dragon appeared on the Luo shore at Luoyang in Henan.

sentences.zh: 泰始元年十二月，白龍二見太原祁。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of Taishi, two white dragons appeared at Qi in Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the first year of Taishi, two white dragons appeared at Qi in Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 泰始二年七月壬午，黃龍見巴西閬中。

translations.literal: On the day renwu of the seventh month of the second year of Taishi, a yellow dragon appeared at Langzhong in Ba in Brazil.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the seventh month in the second year of Taishi, a yellow dragon appeared at Langzhong in Brazil.

sentences.zh: 泰始三年四月戊午，有司奏：「張掖太守焦勝言，氐池縣大柳谷口青龍見。」

translations.literal: On the day wuwu of the fourth month of the third year of Taishi, the responsible offices memorialized: "Inspector of Zhangye Jiao Sheng reports that a blue dragon appeared at the mouth of Great Willow Valley in Dichi County."
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the fourth month in the third year of Taishi, the authorities reported: "Zhangye Inspector Jiao Sheng states that a blue dragon appeared at the mouth of Great Willow Valley in Dichi County."

sentences.zh: 晉武帝咸寧二年六月丙申，白龍二見于新興九原居民井中。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen of the sixth month of the second year of the Xianning reign of Emperor Wu of Jin, two white dragons appeared in wells among the commoners of Jiuyuan in Xinxing.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the sixth month in the second year of Xianning, two white dragons appeared in residential wells at Jiuyuan in Xinxing.

sentences.zh: 咸寧二年十月庚午，黃龍二見于漢嘉靈關。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu of the tenth month of the second year of Xianning, two yellow dragons appeared at Ling Pass in Hanjia.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the tenth month in the second year of Xianning, two yellow dragons appeared at Ling Pass in Hanjia.

sentences.zh: 咸寧二年十一月癸巳，白龍二見須度支部。

translations.literal: On the day jisi of the eleventh month of the second year of Xianning, two white dragons appeared in the Xudu tribal district.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the eleventh month in the second year of Xianning, two white dragons appeared in the Xudu tribal district.

sentences.zh: 咸寧五年十一月甲寅，青龍見京兆霸城。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin of the eleventh month of the fifth year of Xianning, a blue dragon appeared at Bacheng in Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the eleventh month in the fifth year of Xianning, a blue dragon appeared at Bacheng in Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 晉武帝太康元年八月，白龍三見于永昌。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of the Taikang reign of Emperor Wu of Jin, white dragons appeared three times in Yongchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of Taikang, white dragons appeared three times in Yongchang.

sentences.zh: 太康三年閏四月己丑，白龍二見濟南歷城。

translations.literal: On the day jichou of the intercalary fourth month of the third year of Taikang, two white dragons appeared at Licheng in Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day of the intercalary fourth month in the third year of Taikang, two white dragons appeared at Licheng in Jinan.

sentences.zh: 太康五年正月癸卯，青龍二見武庫井中，帝親往觀之。

translations.literal: On the day guimao of the first month of the fifth year of Taikang, two blue dragons appeared in the armory well; the emperor went in person to view them.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the first month in the fifth year of Taikang, two blue dragons appeared in the armory well, and the emperor went to see them himself.

sentences.zh: 太康六年九月，白龍見京兆陰槃。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the sixth year of Taikang, a white dragon appeared at Yinpan in Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the sixth year of Taikang, a white dragon appeared at Yinpan in Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 太康九年十二月戊申，青龍一見魯國公丘居民井中。

translations.literal: On the day wushen of the twelfth month of the ninth year of Taikang, a blue dragon appeared in a well among the commoners of Gongqiu in Lu.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the twelfth month in the ninth year of Taikang, a blue dragon appeared in a commoner's well at Gongqiu in Lu.

sentences.zh: 晉惠帝元康七年三月己酉朔，成臯縣獄有龍昇天。

translations.literal: On the first day jiyou of the third month of the seventh year of the Yuankang reign of Emperor Hui of Jin, a dragon ascended to Heaven from the prison at Chenggao County.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou new moon of the third month in the seventh year of Yuankang, a dragon rose to Heaven from the prison at Chenggao County.

sentences.zh: 宋武帝永初元年七月，青龍見義興陽羨。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of the Yongchu reign of Emperor Wu of Song, a blue dragon appeared at Yangxian in Yixing.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of Yongchu, a blue dragon appeared at Yangxian in Yixing.

sentences.zh: 永初元年八月，青龍二見南郡江陵。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Yongchu, two blue dragons appeared at Jiangling in Nan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of Yongchu, two blue dragons appeared at Jiangling in Nan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 文帝元嘉十三年九月己酉，會稽郡西南向曉，忽大光明，有青龍騰躍凌雲，久而後滅。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou of the ninth month of the thirteenth year of the Yuanjia reign of Emperor Wen, toward dawn in the southwest of Kuaiji Commandery there was suddenly a great radiance; a blue dragon soared leaping above the clouds and only after a long while vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the ninth month in the thirteenth year of Yuanjia, at dawn in southwestern Kuaiji a great light suddenly flared; a blue dragon leapt soaring through the clouds and only after a long interval faded away.

sentences.zh: 吳興諸處並以其日同見光景。

translations.literal: Several places in Wuxing on the same day likewise saw the same radiance.
translations.idiomatic: Several districts in Wuxing on the same day also beheld the same light.

sentences.zh: 揚州刺史彭城王義康以聞。

translations.literal: The Inspector of Yang Province, the Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, reported it.
translations.idiomatic: Yikang, Prince of Pengcheng and inspector of Yang Province, reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十一年十月己丑，永嘉永寧見黃龍自雲而下，太守臧藝以聞。

translations.literal: On the day jichou of the tenth month of the twenty-first year of Yuanjia, Yongning in Yongjia saw a yellow dragon descend from the clouds; Inspector Zang Yi reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day of the tenth month in the twenty-first year of Yuanjia, Yongning in Yongjia saw a yellow dragon descend from the clouds, and Inspector Zang Yi reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十五年五月丁丑，黑龍見玄武湖北，苑丞王世宗以聞。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou of the fifth month of the twenty-fifth year of Yuanjia, a black dragon appeared north of Xuanwu Lake; Park Superintendent Wang Shizong reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the fifth month in the twenty-fifth year of Yuanjia, a black dragon appeared north of Xuanwu Lake, and Park Superintendent Wang Shizong reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十五年五月戊戌，黑龍見玄武湖東北隈，揚州野吏張立之以聞。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu of the fifth month of the twenty-fifth year of Yuanjia, a black dragon appeared in the northeastern bend of Xuanwu Lake; Yang Province field clerk Zhang Lizhi reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the fifth month in the twenty-fifth year of Yuanjia, a black dragon appeared in the northeastern recess of Xuanwu Lake, and Zhang Lizhi, field clerk of Yang Province, reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十五年八月辛亥，黃龍見會稽，太守孟顗以聞。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai of the eighth month of the twenty-fifth year of Yuanjia, a yellow dragon appeared in Kuaiji; Inspector Meng Yi reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the eighth month in the twenty-fifth year of Yuanjia, a yellow dragon appeared in Kuaiji, and Inspector Meng Yi reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十五年，廣陵有龍自湖水中升天，百姓皆見。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year of Yuanjia, at Guangling a dragon ascended to Heaven from the lake waters, and the common people all saw it.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year of Yuanjia, at Guangling a dragon rose to Heaven from the lake, witnessed by the common people.

sentences.zh: 孝武帝孝建二年七月癸丑，黃龍見石頭城外水濱，中護軍湘東王彧以聞。

translations.literal: On the day guichou of the seventh month of the second year of the Xiaojian reign of Emperor Xiaowu, a yellow dragon appeared on the waterside outside Stone City; Central Guard General the Prince of Xiangdong Yu reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day of the seventh month in the second year of Xiaojian, a yellow dragon appeared on the waters outside Stone City, and Yu, Prince of Xiangdong and Central Guard General, reported it.

sentences.zh: 孝建三年五月己未，龍見臨川郡，江州刺史東海王褘以聞。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei of the fifth month of the third year of Xiaojian, a dragon appeared in Linchuan Commandery; the Inspector of Jiang Province, the Prince of Donghai Hui, reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the fifth month in the third year of Xiaojian, a dragon appeared in Linchuan Commandery, and Hui, Prince of Donghai and inspector of Jiang Province, reported it.

sentences.zh: 孝武大明元年五月癸亥，黑龍見晉陵占石邨。

translations.literal: On the day guihai of the fifth month of the first year of the Daming reign of Emperor Xiaowu, a black dragon appeared at Zhanshi Village in Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the fifth month in the first year of Daming, a black dragon appeared at Zhanshi Village in Jinling.

sentences.zh: 改邨為津里。

translations.literal: The village was renamed Jinli.
translations.idiomatic: The village was renamed Jinli.

sentences.zh: 靈龜者，神龜也。

translations.literal: The numinous tortoise is a divine turtle.
translations.idiomatic: The numinous tortoise is a sacred turtle.

sentences.zh: 王者德澤湛清，漁獵山川從時則出。

translations.literal: When a king's virtue is deep and clear as water, and fishing and hunting in mountains and rivers follow the seasons, it emerges.
translations.idiomatic: When a sovereign's virtue is pure and deep as still water, and hunting and fishing in hills and streams observe the seasons, it appears.

sentences.zh: 五色鮮明，三百歲游於蕖葉之上，三千歲常游於卷耳之上。

translations.literal: Its five colors are bright and distinct; at three hundred years it roams upon lotus leaves; at three thousand years it constantly roams upon cocklebur leaves.
translations.idiomatic: Its five colors shine clear; at three hundred years it glides upon lotus leaves, at three thousand it dwells upon cocklebur leaves.

sentences.zh: 知存亡，明於吉凶。

translations.literal: It knows survival and extinction and is clear regarding fortune and misfortune.
translations.idiomatic: It knows what lives and what perishes and discerns good and ill fortune.

sentences.zh: 禹卑宮室，靈龜見。

translations.literal: When Yu built humble palaces, the numinous tortoise appeared.
translations.idiomatic: When Yu dwelt in lowly halls, the numinous tortoise appeared.

sentences.zh: 玄龜書者，天符也。

translations.literal: The dark-turtle writ is Heaven's tally.
translations.idiomatic: The dark-turtle writ is Heaven's token.

sentences.zh: 王者德至淵泉，則雒出龜書。

translations.literal: When a king's virtue reaches the deep springs, the Luo yields the turtle writ.
translations.idiomatic: When a sovereign's virtue reaches the deepest springs, the Luo River brings forth the turtle writ.

sentences.zh: 魏文帝初，神龜出於靈池。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Emperor Wen of Wei, a divine turtle emerged from the Spirit Pool.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Emperor Wen of Wei's reign, a divine turtle came forth from the Spirit Pool.

sentences.zh: 吳孫權時，靈龜出會稽章安。

translations.literal: In the time of Sun Quan of Wu, a numinous tortoise appeared at Zhang'an in Kuaiji.
translations.idiomatic: During the reign of Sun Quan of Wu, a numinous tortoise appeared at Zhang'an in Kuaiji.

sentences.zh: 魏元帝咸熙二年二月甲辰，朐䏰縣獲靈龜以獻。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen of the second month of the second year of the Xianxi reign of Emperor Yuan of Wei, Quyu County obtained a numinous tortoise and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day of the second month in the second year of Xianxi, Quyu County captured a numinous tortoise and presented it.

sentences.zh: 晉長沙王乂坐同產兄楚王瑋事，徙封常山，後還復國。

translations.literal: The Prince of Changsha Yi, implicated in the affair of his uterine brother the Prince of Chu Wei, was demoted to Prince of Changshan and later restored to his former fief.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yi of Changsha, caught up in the case of his full brother Prince Wei of Chu, was transferred to Changshan and later restored to his original domain.

sentences.zh: 在常山穿井，入地四丈，得白玉方三四尺。

translations.literal: While digging a well in Changshan, four zhang into the earth, he obtained a square of white jade three or four chi across.
translations.idiomatic: Digging a well in Changshan, four zhang down he found a block of white jade three or four chi square.

sentences.zh: 玉下有大石，其中有龜長二尺餘，時人以為復國之祥。

translations.literal: Beneath the jade was a great stone; within it was a turtle more than two chi long; people of the time took it as an omen of restoration of the state.
translations.idiomatic: Under the jade lay a great stone containing a turtle more than two chi long; contemporaries regarded it as an omen of restoration.

sentences.zh: 宋文帝元嘉十九年四月戊申，白龜見吳興餘杭，太守文道恩以獻。

translations.literal: On the day wushen of the fourth month of the nineteenth year of the Yuanjia reign of Emperor Wen, a white turtle appeared at Yuhang in Wuxing; Inspector Wen Dao'en presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the fourth month in the nineteenth year of Yuanjia, a white turtle appeared at Yuhang in Wuxing, and Inspector Wen Dao'en presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十年四月辛卯，白龜見吳興餘杭，揚州刺史始興王濬以聞。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao of the fourth month of the twentieth year of Yuanjia, a white turtle appeared at Yuhang in Wuxing; the Inspector of Yang Province, the Prince of Shixing Jun, reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the fourth month in the twentieth year of Yuanjia, a white turtle appeared at Yuhang in Wuxing, and Jun, Prince of Shixing and inspector of Yang Province, reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十四年十月甲午，揚州刺史始興王濬獲白龜以獻。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu of the tenth month of the twenty-fourth year of Yuanjia, the Inspector of Yang Province, the Prince of Shixing Jun, obtained a white turtle and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the tenth month in the twenty-fourth year of Yuanjia, Jun, Prince of Shixing and inspector of Yang Province, captured a white turtle and presented it.

sentences.zh: 孝武帝大明三年三月戊子，毛龜見宣城廣德，太守張辯以獻。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi of the third month of the third year of the Daming reign of Emperor Xiaowu, a hairy turtle appeared at Guangde in Xuancheng; Inspector Zhang Bian presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the third month in the third year of Daming, a hairy turtle appeared at Guangde in Xuancheng, and Inspector Zhang Bian presented it.

sentences.zh: 大明四年六月壬寅，車駕幸籍田，白龜見于千畝，尚書右僕射劉秀之以獻。

translations.literal: On the day renyin of the sixth month of the fourth year of Daming, when the imperial carriage visited the sacred field, a white turtle appeared in the thousand-mu plot; Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Liu Xiuzhi presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the sixth month in the fourth year of Daming, during the emperor's visit to the sacred field, a white turtle appeared in the thousand-mu tract, and Vice Director Liu Xiuzhi presented it.

sentences.zh: 大明七年八月乙未，毛龜見新安王子鸞第，獲以獻。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei of the eighth month of the seventh year of Daming, a hairy turtle appeared at the residence of the Prince of Xin'an Ziluan; it was captured and presented.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day of the eighth month in the seventh year of Daming, a hairy turtle appeared at Prince Ziluan of Xin'an's mansion and was captured and presented.

sentences.zh: 明帝泰始二年八月丙辰朔，四眼龜見會稽，會稽太守巴陵王休若以獻。

translations.literal: On the first day bingchen of the eighth month of the second year of the Taishi reign of Emperor Ming, a four-eyed turtle appeared in Kuaiji; the Inspector of Kuaiji, the Prince of Baling Xiuyi, presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen new moon of the eighth month in the second year of Taishi, a four-eyed turtle appeared in Kuaiji, and Xiuyi, Prince of Baling and inspector of Kuaiji, presented it.

sentences.zh: 泰始二年八月丙寅，六眼龜見東陽長山，文如爻卦，太守劉勰以獻。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin of the eighth month of the second year of Taishi, a six-eyed turtle appeared at Changshan in Dongyang, its markings like the hexagram lines; Inspector Liu Xie presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the eighth month in the second year of Taishi, a six-eyed turtle appeared at Changshan in Dongyang with markings like hexagram lines; Inspector Liu Xie presented it.

sentences.zh: 泰始六年九月己巳，八眼龜見吳興故鄣，太守褚淵以獻。

translations.literal: On the day jisi of the ninth month of the sixth year of Taishi, an eight-eyed turtle appeared at Guzhang in Wuxing; Inspector Chu Yuan presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the ninth month in the sixth year of Taishi, an eight-eyed turtle appeared at Guzhang in Wuxing, and Inspector Chu Yuan presented it.

sentences.zh: 明帝泰豫元年十月壬戌，義興陽羨縣獲毛龜，太守王蘊以獻。

translations.literal: On the day renxu of the tenth month of the first year of the Taiyu reign of Emperor Ming, Yangxian County in Yixing obtained a hairy turtle; Inspector Wang Yun presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day of the tenth month in the first year of Taiyu, Yangxian County in Yixing captured a hairy turtle, and Inspector Wang Yun presented it.

sentences.zh: 龍馬者，仁馬也，河水之精。

translations.literal: The dragon-horse is a benevolent horse, the essence of river waters.
translations.idiomatic: The dragon-horse is a horse of benevolence, the quintessence of river water.

sentences.zh: 高八尺五寸，長頸有翼，傍有垂毛，鳴聲九哀。

translations.literal: Eight chi five cun in height, long-necked with wings, with hanging hair at the sides; its cry has nine mournful notes.
translations.idiomatic: It stands eight chi five cun tall, with a long neck and wings and pendulous hair at its flanks; its cry carries nine notes of lament.

sentences.zh: 〈一作音。〉

translations.literal: (One version reads "sound.")
translations.idiomatic: (In another version the text reads "sound" rather than "lament.")

sentences.zh: 騰黃者，神馬也。

translations.literal: Teng Huang is a divine horse.
translations.idiomatic: Teng Huang is a sacred horse.

sentences.zh: 其色黃。

translations.literal: Its color is yellow.
translations.idiomatic: Its color is yellow.

sentences.zh: 王者德御四方則出。

translations.literal: When a king's virtue governs the four quarters, it appears.
translations.idiomatic: When a sovereign's virtue rules the four quarters, it appears.

sentences.zh: 白馬朱鬣，王者任賢良則見。

translations.literal: A white horse with a vermilion mane — when a king employs worthy and good men, it is seen.
translations.idiomatic: A white horse with a cinnabar mane appears when a king places worthy men in office.

sentences.zh: 澤馬者，王者勞來百姓則至。

translations.literal: The marsh horse — when a king labors to comfort the common people, it comes.
translations.idiomatic: The marsh horse comes when a king toils on behalf of the people.

sentences.zh: 夏馬駵，黑身白鬣尾，殷馬駱，白身黑鬣尾，周馬騂，赤身黑鬣尾。

translations.literal: Xia horses were liu — black body with white mane and tail; Shang horses luo — white body with black mane and tail; Zhou horses xing — red body with black mane and tail.
translations.idiomatic: Horses of Xia were liu: black bodies with white manes and tails; of Shang, luo: white bodies with black manes and tails; of Zhou, xing: red bodies with black manes and tails.

sentences.zh: 漢章帝元和中，神馬見郡國。

translations.literal: During the Yuanhe era of Emperor Zhang of Han, divine horses appeared in the commanderies and kingdoms.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yuanhe era under Emperor Zhang of Han, divine horses appeared across the commanderies and kingdoms.

sentences.zh: 晉懷帝永嘉六年二月壬子，神馬鳴南城門。

translations.literal: On the day renzi of the second month of the sixth year of the Yongjia reign of Emperor Huai of Jin, a divine horse neighed at the south gate of the city.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day of the second month in the sixth year of Yongjia, a divine horse neighed at the southern city gate.

sentences.zh: 晉孝武帝太元十四年六月甲申朔，寧州刺史費統上言：「所統晉寧之滇池縣，舊有河水，周回二百餘里。

translations.literal: On the first day jiashen of the sixth month of the fourteenth year of the Taiyuan reign of Emperor Xiaowu of Jin, the Inspector of Ning Province Fei Tong memorialized: "Within my jurisdiction, Dianchi County in Jinning formerly had a river encircling more than two hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen new moon of the sixth month in the fourteenth year of Taiyuan, Ning Province Inspector Fei Tong reported: "Within my jurisdiction, Dianchi County in Jinning once had a river winding more than two hundred li around.

sentences.zh: 六月二十八日辛亥，神馬二匹，一白一黑，忽出於河中，去岸百步。

translations.literal: On the twenty-eighth day xinhai of the sixth month, two divine horses, one white and one black, suddenly emerged from the river a hundred paces from the shore.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-eighth day, xinhai of the sixth month, two divine horses, one white and one black, suddenly came forth from the river a hundred paces from the bank.

sentences.zh: 縣民董聰見之。」

translations.literal: The commoner Dong Cong saw them."
translations.idiomatic: The resident Dong Cong witnessed them."

sentences.zh: 白象者，人君自養有節則至。

translations.literal: The white elephant — when a ruler nourishes himself with measure, it comes.
translations.idiomatic: The white elephant appears when a ruler keeps restraint in his own nurture.

sentences.zh: 宋文帝元嘉元年十二月丙辰，白象見零陵洮陽。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen of the twelfth month of the first year of the Yuanjia reign of Emperor Wen, a white elephant appeared at Taoyang in Lingling.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the twelfth month in the first year of Yuanjia, a white elephant appeared at Taoyang in Lingling.

sentences.zh: 元嘉六年三月丁亥，白象見安成安復，江州刺史南譙王義宣以聞。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai of the third month of the sixth year of Yuanjia, a white elephant appeared at Anfu in Ancheng; the Inspector of Jiang Province, the Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day of the third month in the sixth year of Yuanjia, a white elephant appeared at Anfu in Ancheng, and Yixuan, Prince of Nanqiao and inspector of Jiang Province, reported it.

sentences.zh: 漢武帝元狩二年三月，南越獻馴象。

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year of the Yuanshou reign of Emperor Wu of Han, Nanyue presented tame elephants.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year of Yuanshou, Nanyue presented trained elephants.

sentences.zh: 白狐，王者仁智則至。

translations.literal: The white fox — when a king is benevolent and wise, it comes.
translations.idiomatic: The white fox appears when a sovereign is benevolent and wise.

sentences.zh: 晉成帝咸康八年七月，燕王慕容皝上言白狢見國內。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the eighth year of Xiankang of Emperor Cheng of Jin, the Prince of Yan Murong Huang memorialized that a white badger had appeared within the state.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the eighth year of Xiankang, Prince of Yan Murong Huang reported that a white badger had appeared within his domain.

sentences.zh: 赤熊，佞人遠，姦猾息，則入國。

translations.literal: The red bear — when flatterers are kept distant and treachery and cunning cease, it enters the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The red bear appears when flatterers are kept at bay and treachery and cunning subside.

sentences.zh: 宋文帝元嘉二十年十二月，白熊見新安歙縣，太守到元度以獻。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the twentieth year of Yuanjia of Emperor Wen of Song, a white bear appeared at She County in Xin'an; Inspector Dao Yuandu presented it.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the twentieth year of Yuanjia, a white bear appeared at She County in Xin'an, and Inspector Dao Yuandu presented it.

sentences.zh: 九尾狐，文王得之，東夷歸焉。

translations.literal: The nine-tailed fox — when King Wen obtained it, the Eastern Yi submitted to him.
translations.idiomatic: When King Wen obtained the nine-tailed fox, the Eastern Yi submitted to him.

sentences.zh: 漢章帝元和中，九尾狐見郡國。

translations.literal: During the Yuanhe reign of Emperor Zhang of Han, a nine-tailed fox appeared in the commanderies and states.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yuanhe reign of Emperor Zhang of Han, a nine-tailed fox appeared in the commanderies and states.

sentences.zh: 魏文帝黃初元年十一月甲午，九尾狐見鄄城，又見譙。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day of the eleventh month of the first year of Huangchu of Emperor Wen of Wei, a nine-tailed fox appeared at Juancheng and again at Qiao.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the eleventh month in the first year of Huangchu, a nine-tailed fox appeared at Juancheng and again at Qiao.

sentences.zh: 白鹿，王者明惠及下則至。

translations.literal: The white deer — when a king's enlightened favor extends to those below, it comes.
translations.idiomatic: The white deer appears when a sovereign's enlightened grace reaches those below.

sentences.zh: 漢章帝建初七年十月，車駕西巡，得白鹿於臨平觀。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the seventh year of Jianchu of Emperor Zhang of Han, the imperial carriage toured west and obtained a white deer at Linping Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the seventh year of Jianchu, the emperor toured west and obtained a white deer at Linping Terrace.

sentences.zh: 漢章帝元和中，白鹿見郡國。

translations.literal: During the Yuanhe reign of Emperor Zhang of Han, white deer appeared in the commanderies and states.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yuanhe reign of Emperor Zhang of Han, white deer appeared in the commanderies and states.

sentences.zh: 漢安帝延光三年六月辛未，白鹿見右扶風雍。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day of the sixth month of the third year of Yanguang of Emperor An of Han, a white deer appeared at Yong in Youfufeng.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the sixth month in the third year of Yanguang, a white deer appeared at Yong in Youfufeng.

sentences.zh: 延光三年七月，白鹿見左馮翊。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year of Yanguang, a white deer appeared in Zuofengyi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year of Yanguang, a white deer appeared in Zuofengyi.

sentences.zh: 漢桓帝永興元年二月，白鹿見張掖。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Yongxing of Emperor Huan of Han, a white deer appeared at Zhangye.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of Yongxing, a white deer appeared at Zhangye.

sentences.zh: 魏文帝黃初元年，郡國十九言白鹿及白麋見。

translations.literal: In the first year of Huangchu of Emperor Wen of Wei, nineteen commanderies and states reported white deer and white elk appearing.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Huangchu, nineteen commanderies and states reported white deer and white elk appearing.

sentences.zh: 晉武帝泰始八年十月，白鹿見扶風雍，州刺史嚴詢獲以獻。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the eighth year of Taishi of Emperor Wu of Jin, a white deer appeared at Yong in Fufeng; Inspector Yan Xun of Yong Province captured and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the eighth year of Taishi, a white deer appeared at Yong in Fufeng; Yong Province Inspector Yan Xun captured and presented it.

sentences.zh: 晉武帝太康元年三月，白鹿見零陵泉陵。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Taikang of Emperor Wu of Jin, a white deer appeared at Quanling in Lingling.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the first year of Taikang, a white deer appeared at Quanling in Lingling.

sentences.zh: 太康元年五月甲辰，白鹿見天水西縣，太守劉辛獲以獻。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day of the fifth month of the first year of Taikang, a white deer appeared at Xi County in Tianshui; Inspector Liu Xin captured and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day of the fifth month in the first year of Taikang, a white deer appeared at Xi County in Tianshui, and Inspector Liu Xin captured and presented it.

sentences.zh: 太康三年七月壬子，白鹿見零陵，零陵令蔣微獲以獻。

translations.literal: On the renzi day of the seventh month of the third year of Taikang, a white deer appeared in Lingling; Magistrate Jiang Wei of Lingling captured and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day of the seventh month in the third year of Taikang, a white deer appeared in Lingling; Magistrate Jiang Wei captured and presented it.

sentences.zh: 晉惠帝元康元年九月乙酉，白鹿見交趾武寧。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day of the ninth month of the first year of Yuankang of Emperor Hui of Jin, a white deer appeared at Wuning in Jiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the ninth month in the first year of Yuankang, a white deer appeared at Wuning in Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 晉愍帝建武元年五月戊子，白鹿見高山縣。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day of the fifth month of the first year of Jianwu of Emperor Min of Jin, a white deer appeared at Gaoshan County.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the fifth month in the first year of Jianwu, a white deer appeared at Gaoshan County.

sentences.zh: 晉元帝太興三年正月，白鹿二見豫章。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year of Taixing of Emperor Yuan of Jin, two white deer appeared in Yuzhang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year of Taixing, two white deer appeared in Yuzhang.

sentences.zh: 太興三年四月，白鹿見晉陵延陵。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year of Taixing, a white deer appeared at Yanling in Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year of Taixing, a white deer appeared at Yanling in Jinling.

sentences.zh: 晉元帝永昌元年九月，白鹿見江乘縣。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the first year of Yongchang of Emperor Yuan of Jin, a white deer appeared at Jiangcheng County.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the first year of Yongchang, a white deer appeared at Jiangcheng County.

sentences.zh: 晉成帝咸和四年五月甲子，白鹿見零陵洮陽，獲以獻。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day of the fifth month of the fourth year of Xianhe of Emperor Cheng of Jin, a white deer appeared at Taoyang in Lingling; it was captured and presented.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day of the fifth month in the fourth year of Xianhe, a white deer appeared at Taoyang in Lingling and was captured and presented.

sentences.zh: 咸和四年七月壬寅，長沙郡邏吏黃光於南郡道遇白鹿，驅之不去，直來就光，追尋光三百餘步。

translations.literal: On the renyin day of the seventh month of the fourth year of Xianhe, patrol officer Huang Guang of Changsha Prefecture encountered a white deer on the road in Nan Commandery; he drove it away but it would not leave, coming straight to Guang and following him for more than three hundred paces.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the seventh month in the fourth year of Xianhe, patrol officer Huang Guang of Changsha encountered a white deer on the road in Nan Commandery; though he tried to drive it off, it would not leave, came straight to him, and followed him for more than three hundred paces.

sentences.zh: 光遂抱取，遣吏李堅奉獻。

translations.literal: Guang then took it in his arms and sent officer Li Jian to present it.
translations.idiomatic: Guang then took it in his arms and sent officer Li Jian to present it.

sentences.zh: 咸和九年八月己未，白鹿見長沙臨湘。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day of the eighth month of the ninth year of Xianhe, a white deer appeared at Linxiang in Changsha.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the eighth month in the ninth year of Xianhe, a white deer appeared at Linxiang in Changsha.

sentences.zh: 晉成帝咸康二年七月，白鹿見豫章望蔡，太守桓景獲以獻。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year of Xiankang of Emperor Cheng of Jin, a white deer appeared at Wangcai in Yuzhang; Inspector Huan Jing captured and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year of Xiankang, a white deer appeared at Wangcai in Yuzhang; Inspector Huan Jing captured and presented it.

sentences.zh: 晉孝武太元十六年三月癸酉，白鹿見豫章望蔡，獲以獻。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day of the third month of the sixteenth year of Taixing of Emperor Xiaowu of Jin, a white deer appeared at Wangcai in Yuzhang; it was captured and presented.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the third month in the sixteenth year of Taixing, a white deer appeared at Wangcai in Yuzhang and was captured and presented.

sentences.zh: 太元十八年五月辛酉，白鹿見江乘，江乘令田熙之獲以獻。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day of the fifth month of the eighteenth year of Taixing, a white deer appeared at Jiangcheng; Magistrate Tian Xizhi of Jiangcheng captured and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day of the fifth month in the eighteenth year of Taixing, a white deer appeared at Jiangcheng; Magistrate Tian Xizhi captured and presented it.

sentences.zh: 太元二十年九月丁丑，白鹿見巴陵清水山，荊州刺史殷仲堪以獻。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day of the ninth month of the twentieth year of Taixing, a white deer appeared at Qingshui Mountain in Baling; Inspector Yin Zhongkan of Jing Province presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the ninth month in the twentieth year of Taixing, a white deer appeared at Qingshui Mountain in Baling; Jing Province Inspector Yin Zhongkan presented it.

sentences.zh: 晉安帝隆安五年十一月，白鹿見長沙，荊州刺史桓玄以聞。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the fifth year of Long'an of Emperor An of Jin, a white deer appeared in Changsha; Inspector Huan Xuan of Jing Province reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the fifth year of Long'an, a white deer appeared in Changsha; Jing Province Inspector Huan Xuan reported it.

sentences.zh: 宋文帝元嘉五年七月丙戌，白鹿見東莞莒縣岣峨山，太守劉玄以聞。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day of the seventh month of the fifth year of Yuanjia of Emperor Wen of Song, a white deer appeared at Mount Gou'e in Ju County, Dongguan; Inspector Liu Xuan reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day of the seventh month in the fifth year of Yuanjia, a white deer appeared at Mount Gou'e in Ju County, Dongguan, and Inspector Liu Xuan reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉九年正月，白鹿見南譙譙縣，豫州刺史長沙王義欣以獻。

translations.literal: In the first month of the ninth year of Yuanjia, a white deer appeared at Qiao County in Nanqiao; Inspector the Prince of Changsha, Yixin, of Yu Province presented it.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the ninth year of Yuanjia, a white deer appeared at Qiao County in Nanqiao; Yu Province Inspector the Prince of Changsha, Yixin, presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉十四年，白鹿見文鄉。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Yuanjia, a white deer appeared at Wenxiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Yuanjia, a white deer appeared at Wenxiang.

sentences.zh: 元嘉十七年五月甲午，白鹿見南汝陰宋縣，太守文道恩以獻。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day of the fifth month of the seventeenth year of Yuanjia, a white deer appeared at Song County in Southern Runan; Inspector Wen Dao'en presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the fifth month in the seventeenth year of Yuanjia, a white deer appeared at Song County in Southern Runan, and Inspector Wen Dao'en presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十年八月，白鹿見譙郡蘄縣，太守鄧琬以獻。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twentieth year of Yuanjia, a white deer appeared at Qi County in Qiao Commandery; Inspector Deng Wan presented it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twentieth year of Yuanjia, a white deer appeared at Qi County in Qiao Commandery; Inspector Deng Wan presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十二年二月，白鹿見建康縣，揚州刺史始興王濬以聞。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-second year of Yuanjia, a white deer appeared at Jiankang County; Inspector the Prince of Shixing, Jun, of Yang Province reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twenty-second year of Yuanjia, a white deer appeared at Jiankang County; Yang Province Inspector the Prince of Shixing, Jun, reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十二年二月辛未，白鹿見南康灨縣，南康相劉興祖以獻。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day of the second month of the twenty-second year of Yuanjia, a white deer appeared at Gan County in Nankang; Chancellor Liu Xingzu of Nankang presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the second month in the twenty-second year of Yuanjia, a white deer appeared at Gan County in Nankang; Nankang Chancellor Liu Xingzu presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十三年二月戊戌，白鹿見交州，交州刺史檀和之以獻。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day of the second month of the twenty-third year of Yuanjia, a white deer appeared in Jiaozhou; Inspector Tan Hezhi of Jiaozhou presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the second month in the twenty-third year of Yuanjia, a white deer appeared in Jiaozhou; Jiaozhou Inspector Tan Hezhi presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十三年六月丙辰，白鹿見彭城彭城縣，征北將軍衡陽王義季獲以獻。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day of the sixth month of the twenty-third year of Yuanjia, a white deer appeared at Pengcheng County in Pengcheng; General Who Pacifies the North, the Prince of Hengyang, Yiji, captured and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the sixth month in the twenty-third year of Yuanjia, a white deer appeared at Pengcheng County; General Who Pacifies the North the Prince of Hengyang, Yiji, captured and presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十七年二月壬辰朔，白鹿見濟陰，徐州刺史武陵王駿以聞。

translations.literal: On the first day renchen of the second month of the twenty-seventh year of Yuanjia, a white deer appeared in Jiyin; Inspector the Prince of Wuling, Jun, of Xu Province reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month, renchen, in the twenty-seventh year of Yuanjia, a white deer appeared in Jiyin; Xu Province Inspector the Prince of Wuling, Jun, reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十九年八月癸酉，白鹿見鄱陽，南中郎將武陵王駿以獻。
