translations.literal: On the guiyou day of the eighth month of the twenty-ninth year of Yuanjia, a white deer appeared in Poyang; General of the Southern Gentlemen, the Prince of Wuling, Jun, presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the eighth month in the twenty-ninth year of Yuanjia, a white deer appeared in Poyang; General of the Southern Gentlemen the Prince of Wuling, Jun, presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉三十年十一月壬午，白鹿見南琅邪，南琅邪太守王僧虔以獻。

translations.literal: On the renwu day of the eleventh month of the thirtieth year of Yuanjia, a white deer appeared in Nanlangya; Inspector Wang Sengqian of Nanlangya presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the eleventh month in the thirtieth year of Yuanjia, a white deer appeared in Nanlangya; Nanlangya Inspector Wang Sengqian presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉三十年十一月癸亥，白鹿見武建郡，雍州刺史朱脩之以獻。

translations.literal: On the guihai day of the eleventh month of the thirtieth year of Yuanjia, a white deer appeared in Wujian Commandery; Inspector Zhu Xiuzhi of Yong Province presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the eleventh month in the thirtieth year of Yuanjia, a white deer appeared in Wujian Commandery; Yong Province Inspector Zhu Xiuzhi presented it.

sentences.zh: 孝武帝孝建三年三月庚子，白鹿見臨川西豐縣。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day of the third month of the third year of Xiaojian of Emperor Xiaowu of Song, a white deer appeared at Xifeng County in Linchuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day of the third month in the third year of Xiaojian, a white deer appeared at Xifeng County in Linchuan.

sentences.zh: 孝武帝大明元年四月甲申，白鹿見南平。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day of the fourth month of the first year of Daming of Emperor Xiaowu of Song, a white deer appeared in Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the fourth month in the first year of Daming, a white deer appeared in Nanping.

sentences.zh: 大明二年四月己丑，白鹿見桂陽郴縣，湘州刺史山陽王休祐以獻。

translations.literal: On the jichou day of the fourth month of the second year of Daming, a white deer appeared at Chen County in Guiyang; Inspector the Prince of Shanyang, Xiuyou, of Xiang Province presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day of the fourth month in the second year of Daming, a white deer appeared at Chen County in Guiyang; Xiang Province Inspector the Prince of Shanyang, Xiuyou, presented it.

sentences.zh: 大明三年正月癸巳，白鹿見南琅邪江乘，南徐州刺史劉延孫以獻。

translations.literal: On the guisi day of the first month of the third year of Daming, a white deer appeared at Jiangcheng in Nanlangya; Inspector Liu Yansun of South Xu Province presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day of the first month in the third year of Daming, a white deer appeared at Jiangcheng in Nanlangya; South Xu Province Inspector Liu Yansun presented it.

sentences.zh: 大明三年三月辛卯，白鹿見廣陵新市，太守柳光宗以聞。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day of the third month of the third year of Daming, a white deer appeared at Xinshi in Guangling; Inspector Liu Guangzong reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the third month in the third year of Daming, a white deer appeared at Xinshi in Guangling; Inspector Liu Guangzong reported it.

sentences.zh: 大明五年五月丙寅，白鹿見南東海丹徒，南徐州刺史劉延孫以獻。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day of the fifth month of the fifth year of Daming, a white deer appeared at Dantu in Nandonghai; Inspector Liu Yansun of South Xu Province presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the fifth month in the fifth year of Daming, a white deer appeared at Dantu in Nandonghai; South Xu Province Inspector Liu Yansun presented it.

sentences.zh: 大明八年六月甲子，白鹿見衡陽郡，湘州刺史江夏王世子伯禽以獻。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day of the sixth month of the eighth year of Daming, a white deer appeared in Hengyang Commandery; the heir of the Prince of Jiangxia, Boqin, Inspector of Xiang Province, presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day of the sixth month in the eighth year of Daming, a white deer appeared in Hengyang Commandery; Xiang Province Inspector and heir of the Prince of Jiangxia, Boqin, presented it.

sentences.zh: 明帝泰始二年二月乙亥，白鹿見宣城，宣城太守劉韞以聞。

translations.literal: On the yihai day of the second month of the second year of Taishi of Emperor Ming of Song, a white deer appeared in Xuancheng; Inspector Liu Yun of Xuancheng reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day of the second month in the second year of Taishi, a white deer appeared in Xuancheng; Xuancheng Inspector Liu Yun reported it.

sentences.zh: 泰始五年二月己亥，白鹿見長沙，湘州刺史劉韞以獻。

translations.literal: On the jihai day of the second month of the fifth year of Taishi, a white deer appeared in Changsha; Inspector Liu Yun of Xiang Province presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the second month in the fifth year of Taishi, a white deer appeared in Changsha; Xiang Province Inspector Liu Yun presented it.

sentences.zh: 泰始六年十二月乙未，白鹿見梁州，梁州刺史杜幼文以聞。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day of the twelfth month of the sixth year of Taishi, a white deer appeared in Liang Province; Inspector Du Youwen of Liang Province reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day of the twelfth month in the sixth year of Taishi, a white deer appeared in Liang Province; Liang Province Inspector Du Youwen reported it.

sentences.zh: 後廢帝元徽三年二月甲子，白鹿見鬱洲，青冀二州刺史、西海太守劉善明以獻。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day of the second month of the third year of Yuanhui of the Deposed Emperor of Later Song, a white deer appeared at Yuzhou; Inspector of Qing and Ji Provinces and Inspector of Xihai, Liu Shanming, presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day of the second month in the third year of Yuanhui, a white deer appeared at Yuzhou; Qing and Ji Provinces Inspector and Xihai Inspector Liu Shanming presented it.

sentences.zh: 三角獸，先王法度修則至。

translations.literal: The three-horned beast — when the former kings' laws and standards are cultivated, it comes.
translations.idiomatic: The three-horned beast appears when the laws and standards of the former kings are properly maintained.

translations.literal: (Lacuna.)
translations.idiomatic: (The passage is lost in the source.)

sentences.zh: 一角獸，天下平一則至。

translations.literal: The one-horned beast — when all under Heaven is unified and at peace, it comes.
translations.idiomatic: The one-horned beast appears when the realm is unified and at peace.

translations.literal: (Lacuna.)
translations.idiomatic: (The passage is lost in the source.)

sentences.zh: 六足獸，王者謀及眾庶則至。

translations.literal: The six-legged beast — when a king's deliberations reach the common people, it comes.
translations.idiomatic: The six-legged beast appears when a sovereign's counsel reaches the common people.

translations.literal: (Lacuna.)
translations.idiomatic: (The passage is lost in the source.)

sentences.zh: 比肩獸，王者德及矜寡則至。

translations.literal: The side-by-side beast — when a king's virtue reaches the pity-worthy and the widowed, it comes.
translations.idiomatic: The side-by-side beast appears when a sovereign's virtue reaches the needy and the widowed.

translations.literal: (Lacuna.)
translations.idiomatic: (The passage is lost in the source.)

sentences.zh: 獬豸知曲直，獄訟平則至。

translations.literal: The xiezhi knows right from wrong; when prison cases and lawsuits are balanced, it comes.
translations.idiomatic: The xiezhi discerns right from wrong; it appears when prison cases and lawsuits are justly settled.

translations.literal: (Lacuna.)
translations.idiomatic: (The passage is lost in the source.)

sentences.zh: 白虎，王者不暴虐，則白虎仁，不害物。

translations.literal: The white tiger — when a king is not cruel and tyrannical, the white tiger is benevolent and does not harm living things.
translations.idiomatic: When a sovereign is not cruel or tyrannical, the white tiger becomes benevolent and does not harm living things.

sentences.zh: 漢宣帝元康四年，南郡獲白虎。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yuankang of Emperor Xuan of Han, Nan Commandery captured a white tiger.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Yuankang, Nan Commandery captured a white tiger.

sentences.zh: 漢章帝元和二年以來，至章和元年，凡三年，白虎二十九見郡國。

translations.literal: From the second year of Yuanhe of Emperor Zhang of Han until the first year of Zhanghe, three years in all, white tigers appeared twenty-nine times in the commanderies and states.
translations.idiomatic: From the second year of Yuanhe through the first year of Zhanghe—three years in all—white tigers appeared twenty-nine times in the commanderies and states.

sentences.zh: 漢安帝延光三年八月戊子，白虎二見潁川陽翟。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day of the eighth month of the third year of Yanguang of Emperor An of Han, two white tigers appeared at Yangdi in Yingchuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the eighth month in the third year of Yanguang, two white tigers appeared at Yangdi in Yingchuan.

sentences.zh: 漢獻帝延康元年四月丁巳，饒安縣言白虎見。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day of the fourth month of the first year of Yankang of Emperor Xian of Han, Ra'o'an County reported a white tiger appearing.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the fourth month in the first year of Yankang, Ra'o'an County reported a white tiger appearing.

sentences.zh: 又郡國二十七言白虎見。

translations.literal: Also, twenty-seven commanderies and states reported white tigers appearing.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-seven commanderies and states also reported white tigers appearing.

sentences.zh: 吳孫權赤烏六年正月，新都言白虎見。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixth year of Chiwu of Sun Quan of Wu, Xindu reported a white tiger appearing.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixth year of Chiwu, Xindu reported a white tiger appearing.

sentences.zh: 赤烏十一年五月，鄱陽言白虎仁。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eleventh year of Chiwu, Poyang reported a benevolent white tiger.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eleventh year of Chiwu, Poyang reported a benevolent white tiger.

sentences.zh: 晉武帝泰始元年十二月，白虎見河南陽翟。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of Taishi of Emperor Wu of Jin, a white tiger appeared at Yangdi in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the first year of Taishi, a white tiger appeared at Yangdi in Henan.

sentences.zh: 泰始元年十二月，白虎見弘農陸渾。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of Taishi, a white tiger appeared at Luhun in Hongnong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the first year of Taishi, a white tiger appeared at Luhun in Hongnong.

sentences.zh: 泰始二年正月己亥，白虎見遼東樂浪。

translations.literal: On the jihai day of the first month of the second year of Taishi, a white tiger appeared in Liaodong and at Lepang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the first month in the second year of Taishi, a white tiger appeared in Liaodong and at Lepang.

sentences.zh: 泰始二年正月辛丑，白虎見天水西。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day of the first month of the second year of Taishi, a white tiger appeared at Xi in Tianshui.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the first month in the second year of Taishi, a white tiger appeared at Xi in Tianshui.

sentences.zh: 晉武帝咸寧三年二月乙丑，白虎見沛國。

translations.literal: On the yichou day of the second month of the third year of Xianning of Emperor Wu of Jin, a white tiger appeared in Pei State.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the second month in the third year of Xianning, a white tiger appeared in Pei State.

sentences.zh: 晉武帝太康元年八月，白虎見永昌南罕。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Taikang of Emperor Wu of Jin, a white tiger appeared at Nanhan in Yongchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of Taikang, a white tiger appeared at Nanhan in Yongchang.

sentences.zh: 太康四年七月丙辰，白虎見建平北井。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day of the seventh month of the fourth year of Taikang, a white tiger appeared at Beijing in Jianping.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the seventh month in the fourth year of Taikang, a white tiger appeared at Beijing in Jianping.

sentences.zh: 太康十年十月丁酉，白虎見犍為。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day of the tenth month of the tenth year of Taikang, a white tiger appeared in Jianwei.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the tenth month in the tenth year of Taikang, a white tiger appeared in Jianwei.

sentences.zh: 晉成帝咸和八年五月己巳，白虎見新昌縣。

translations.literal: On the jisi day of the fifth month of the eighth year of Xianhe of Emperor Cheng of Jin, a white tiger appeared at Xinchang County.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the fifth month in the eighth year of Xianhe, a white tiger appeared at Xinchang County.

sentences.zh: 晉簡文帝咸安二年三月，白虎見豫章南昌縣西鄉石馬山前。

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year of Xi'an of Emperor Jianwen of Jin, a white tiger appeared before Stone Horse Mountain in the western township of Nanchang County, Yuzhang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year of Xi'an, a white tiger appeared before Stone Horse Mountain in the western township of Nanchang County, Yuzhang.

sentences.zh: 晉孝武太元十四年十一月辛亥，白虎見豫章郡。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day of the eleventh month of the fourteenth year of Taixing of Emperor Xiaowu of Jin, a white tiger appeared in Yuzhang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the eleventh month in the fourteenth year of Taixing, a white tiger appeared in Yuzhang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 太元十九年二月，行鞏令劉啟期言白虎頻見。

translations.literal: In the second month of the nineteenth year of Taixing, Acting Magistrate of Gong Liu Qike reported white tigers appearing frequently.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the nineteenth year of Taixing, Acting Magistrate of Gong Liu Qike reported white tigers appearing frequently.

sentences.zh: 太元十九年二月，行溫令趙邳言白虎頻見。

translations.literal: In the second month of the nineteenth year of Taixing, Acting Magistrate of Wen Zhao Pi reported white tigers appearing frequently.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the nineteenth year of Taixing, Acting Magistrate of Wen Zhao Pi reported white tigers appearing frequently.

sentences.zh: 晉安帝隆安五年十一月，襄陽言騶虞見於新野。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the fifth year of Long'an of Emperor An of Jin, Xiangyang reported a zouyu appearing at Xinye.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the fifth year of Long'an, Xiangyang reported a zouyu appearing at Xinye.

sentences.zh: 宋武帝永初元年八月癸巳，白虎見枝江。

translations.literal: On the guisi day of the eighth month of the first year of Yongchu of Emperor Wu of Song, a white tiger appeared at Zhijiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day of the eighth month in the first year of Yongchu, a white tiger appeared at Zhijiang.

sentences.zh: 少帝景平元年十月，白虎見桂陽耒陽。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Jingping of the Deposed Emperor, a white tiger appeared at Leiyang in Guiyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the first year of Jingping, a white tiger appeared at Leiyang in Guiyang.

sentences.zh: 文帝元嘉十九年十月，白虎見弋陽、期思二縣，南豫州刺史武陵王駿以聞。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the nineteenth year of Yuanjia of Emperor Wen, white tigers appeared in the two counties of Yiyang and Qisi; Inspector the Prince of Wuling, Jun, of South Yu Province reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the nineteenth year of Yuanjia, white tigers appeared in Yiyang and Qisi counties; South Yu Province Inspector the Prince of Wuling, Jun, reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十五年二月己亥，白虎見武昌，武昌太守蔡興宗以聞。

translations.literal: On the jihai day of the second month of the twenty-fifth year of Yuanjia, a white tiger appeared at Wuchang; Inspector Cai Xingzong of Wuchang reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the second month in the twenty-fifth year of Yuanjia, a white tiger appeared at Wuchang; Wuchang Inspector Cai Xingzong reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十五年十一月丁丑，白虎見蜀郡二，赤虎導前，益州刺史陸徽以聞。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day of the eleventh month of the twenty-fifth year of Yuanjia, two white tigers appeared in Shu Commandery, with a red tiger leading the way; Inspector Lu Hui of Yi Province reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the eleventh month in the twenty-fifth year of Yuanjia, two white tigers appeared in Shu Commandery with a red tiger leading the way; Yi Province Inspector Lu Hui reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十六年四月戊戌，白虎見南琅邪半陽山，二虎隨從，太守王僧達以聞。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day of the fourth month of the twenty-sixth year of Yuanjia, a white tiger appeared at Mount Banyang in Nanlangya, with two tigers following; Inspector Wang Sengda reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the fourth month in the twenty-sixth year of Yuanjia, a white tiger appeared at Mount Banyang in Nanlangya with two tigers following; Inspector Wang Sengda reported it.

sentences.zh: 孝武孝建三年三月壬子，白虎見臨川西豐。

translations.literal: On the renzi day of the third month of the third year of Xiaojian of Emperor Xiaowu, a white tiger appeared at Xifeng in Linchuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day of the third month in the third year of Xiaojian, a white tiger appeared at Xifeng in Linchuan.

sentences.zh: 白狼，宣王得之而犬戎服。

translations.literal: The white wolf — when King Xuan obtained it, the Quanrong submitted.
translations.idiomatic: When King Xuan obtained the white wolf, the Quanrong submitted.

translations.literal: (Lacuna.)
translations.idiomatic: (The passage is lost in the source.)

sentences.zh: 白麞，王者刑罰理則至。

translations.literal: The white roe deer — when a king's punishments are rightly ordered, it comes.
translations.idiomatic: The white roe deer appears when a sovereign's punishments are justly administered.

sentences.zh: 晉武帝咸寧元年四月丙戌、乙卯，白麞見琅邪，趙王倫以獻。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Xianning of Emperor Wu of Jin, on the bingxu and yimao days, a white roe deer appeared in Langya; the Prince of Zhao, Lun, presented it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of Xianning, on the bingxu and yimao days, a white roe deer appeared in Langya; the Prince of Zhao, Lun, presented it.

sentences.zh: 咸寧三年七月壬辰，白麞見魏郡。

translations.literal: On the renchen day of the seventh month of the third year of Xianning, a white roe deer appeared in Wei Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day of the seventh month in the third year of Xianning, a white roe deer appeared in Wei Commandery.

sentences.zh: 晉武帝太康三年八月，白麞見梁國蒙，梁相解隆獲以獻。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year of Taikang of Emperor Wu of Jin, a white roe deer appeared at Meng in Liang State; Chancellor Jie Long of Liang captured and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the third year of Taikang, a white roe deer appeared at Meng in Liang State; Liang Chancellor Jie Long captured and presented it.

sentences.zh: 太康五年九月己酉，白麞見義陽。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day of the ninth month of the fifth year of Taikang, a white roe deer appeared in Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the ninth month in the fifth year of Taikang, a white roe deer appeared in Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 太康七年五月戊辰，白麞見汲郡。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day of the fifth month of the seventh year of Taikang, a white roe deer appeared in Ji Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the fifth month in the seventh year of Taikang, a white roe deer appeared in Ji Commandery.

sentences.zh: 晉成帝咸和九年五月癸酉，白麞見吳國吳縣，內史虞潭獲以獻。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the ninth year of Xianhe of Emperor Cheng of Jin, on the guiyou day, a white roe deer appeared in Wu County, Wu Kingdom; Interior Administrator Yu Tan captured and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the ninth year of Xianhe, on the guiyou day, a white roe deer appeared in Wu County; Interior Administrator Yu Tan captured and presented it.

sentences.zh: 晉穆帝永和元年八月，白麞見吳國吳縣西界包山，獲以獻。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Yonghe of Emperor Mu of Jin, a white roe deer appeared at Mount Bao on the western border of Wu County, Wu Kingdom; it was captured and presented.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of Yonghe, a white roe deer appeared at Mount Bao on the western border of Wu County; it was captured and presented.

sentences.zh: 永和八年十二月，白麞見丹陽永世，永世令徐該獲以獻。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the eighth year of Yonghe, a white roe deer appeared in Yongshi, Danyang; Magistrate Xu Gai captured and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the eighth year of Yonghe, a white roe deer appeared in Yongshi, Danyang; Magistrate Xu Gai captured and presented it.

sentences.zh: 永和十二年十一月庚午，白麞見梁郡，梁郡太守劉遂獲以獻。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day of the eleventh month of the twelfth year of Yonghe, a white roe deer appeared in Liang Commandery; Administrator Liu Sui captured and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the eleventh month in the twelfth year of Yonghe, a white roe deer appeared in Liang Commandery; Administrator Liu Sui captured and presented it.

sentences.zh: 晉安帝隆安五年十一月，白麞見荊州，荊州刺史桓玄以聞。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the fifth year of Long'an of Emperor An of Jin, a white roe deer appeared in Jing Province; Inspector Huan Xuan reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the fifth year of Long'an, a white roe deer appeared in Jing Province; Inspector Huan Xuan reported it.

sentences.zh: 宋少帝景平元年五月癸未，白麞見義興陽羨，太守王準之獲以獻。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day of the fifth month of the first year of Jingping of Emperor Shao of Song, a white roe deer appeared in Yangxian, Yixing; Administrator Wang Zhunzhi captured and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day of the fifth month in the first year of Jingping, a white roe deer appeared in Yangxian, Yixing; Administrator Wang Zhunzhi captured and presented it.

sentences.zh: 景平二年六月，白麞見南郡江陽，太守王華獻之太祖。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the second year of Jingping, a white roe deer appeared in Jiangyang, Nan Commandery; Administrator Wang Hua presented it to the Founding Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year of Jingping, a white roe deer appeared in Jiangyang, Nan Commandery; Administrator Wang Hua presented it to the Founding Emperor.

sentences.zh: 太祖時入奉大統，以為休祥。

translations.literal: When the Founding Emperor was receiving the great succession, it was regarded as a propitious omen.
translations.idiomatic: When the Founding Emperor was taking up the imperial succession, the gift was taken as a propitious omen.

sentences.zh: 文帝元嘉五年四月乙巳，白麞見汝陽武津，太守鄭據獲以獻。

translations.literal: On the yisi day of the fourth month of the fifth year of Yuanjia of Emperor Wen, a white roe deer appeared at Wujin, Ruyang; Administrator Zheng Ju captured and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day of the fourth month in the fifth year of Yuanjia, a white roe deer appeared at Wujin, Ruyang; Administrator Zheng Ju captured and presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉十二年正月，白麞見東萊黃縣，青、冀州刺史王方回以獻。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twelfth year of Yuanjia, a white roe deer appeared in Huang County, Donglai; Qing and Ji Inspector Wang Fanghui presented it.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twelfth year of Yuanjia, a white roe deer appeared in Huang County, Donglai; Qing and Ji Inspector Wang Fanghui presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉十九年五月，山陽張休宗獲白麞，南兗州刺史臨川王義慶以獻。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the nineteenth year of Yuanjia, Zhang Xiuzong of Shanyang captured a white roe deer; Nan Yanzhou Inspector the Prince of Linchuan, Liu Yiqing, presented it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the nineteenth year of Yuanjia, Zhang Xiuzong of Shanyang captured a white roe deer; Nan Yanzhou Inspector the Prince of Linchuan, Liu Yiqing, presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十年八月，白麞見江夏安陸，內史劉思考以獻。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twentieth year of Yuanjia, a white roe deer appeared in Anlu, Jiangxia; Interior Administrator Liu Sikao presented it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twentieth year of Yuanjia, a white roe deer appeared in Anlu, Jiangxia; Interior Administrator Liu Sikao presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十五年二月己丑，白麞見淮南，太守王休獲以獻。

translations.literal: On the jichou day of the second month of the twenty-fifth year of Yuanjia, a white roe deer appeared in Huainan; Administrator Wang Xiu captured and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day of the second month in the twenty-fifth year of Yuanjia, a white roe deer appeared in Huainan; Administrator Wang Xiu captured and presented it.

translations.literal: On the wuwu day of the fourth month of the twenty-fifth year of Yuanjia, a white roe deer appeared in Nan Langya; Administrator Wang Yuan captured and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the fourth month in the twenty-fifth year of Yuanjia, a white roe deer appeared in Nan Langya; Administrator Wang Yuan captured and presented it.

translations.literal: On the first day, xinwei, of the fifth month of the twenty-fifth year of Yuanjia, a white roe deer in the Hualin Park gave birth to two young, both white; Park Superintendent Mei Daonian reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month, xinwei, in the twenty-fifth year of Yuanjia, a white roe deer in the Hualin Park bore two fawns, both white; Park Superintendent Mei Daonian reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十六年五月丙戌，白麞見馬頭，豫州刺史南平王鑠以獻。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day of the fifth month of the twenty-sixth year of Yuanjia, a white roe deer appeared at Matou; Yanzhou Inspector the Prince of Nanping, Liu Shuo, presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day of the fifth month in the twenty-sixth year of Yuanjia, a white roe deer appeared at Matou; Yanzhou Inspector the Prince of Nanping, Liu Shuo, presented it.

translations.literal: On the jichou day of the first month of the twenty-seventh year of Yuanjia, a white roe deer appeared in Jiyin; Xuzhou Inspector the Prince of Wuling, Liu Jun, reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day of the first month in the twenty-seventh year of Yuanjia, a white roe deer appeared in Jiyin; Xuzhou Inspector the Prince of Wuling, Liu Jun, reported it.

translations.literal: On the renxu day of the sixth month of the twenty-ninth year of Yuanjia, a white roe deer appeared in Jiyang, Jinling; Nan Xuzhou Inspector the Prince of Shixing, Liu Jun, presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day of the sixth month in the twenty-ninth year of Yuanjia, a white roe deer appeared in Jiyang, Jinling; Nan Xuzhou Inspector the Prince of Shixing, Liu Jun, presented it.

sentences.zh: 孝武帝孝建三年六月癸巳，白麞見廣陵，南兗州以獻。

translations.literal: On the guisi day of the sixth month of the third year of Xiaojian of Emperor Xiaowu, a white roe deer appeared in Guangling; Nan Yanzhou presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day of the sixth month in the third year of Xiaojian, a white roe deer appeared in Guangling; Nan Yanzhou presented it.

sentences.zh: 孝武帝大明元年七月丁丑，白麞見東萊曲城縣，獲以獻。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day of the seventh month of the first year of Daming of Emperor Xiaowu, a white roe deer appeared in Qucheng County, Donglai; it was captured and presented.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the seventh month in the first year of Daming, a white roe deer appeared in Qucheng County, Donglai; it was captured and presented.

translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day of the first month in the second year of Daming, a white roe deer appeared in Shanyang; Interior Administrator Cheng Tianzuo presented it.

translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the second month in the second year of Daming, a white roe deer appeared in Jibei; Administrator Yin Xiaozu presented it.

translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the ninth month in the fifth year of Daming, a white roe deer appeared in Nanyang; Yongzhou Inspector the Prince of Yongjia, Liu Ziren, presented it.

translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the first month in the seventh year of Daming, a white roe deer appeared in Nanyang; Jingzhou Inspector the Prince of Linhai, Liu Zixiang, presented it.

sentences.zh: 大明七年六月己巳，白麞見武陵臨沅，太守劉衍以獻。

translations.literal: On the jisi day of the sixth month of the seventh year of Daming, a white roe deer appeared in Linyuan, Wuling; Administrator Liu Yan presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the sixth month in the seventh year of Daming, a white roe deer appeared in Linyuan, Wuling; Administrator Liu Yan presented it.

sentences.zh: 大明七年九月癸未，白麞見南陽，雍州刺史劉秀之以獻。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day of the ninth month of the seventh year of Daming, a white roe deer appeared in Nanyang; Yongzhou Inspector Liu Xiuzhi presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day of the ninth month in the seventh year of Daming, a white roe deer appeared in Nanyang; Yongzhou Inspector Liu Xiuzhi presented it.

translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the fifth month in the third year of Taishi, a white roe deer appeared in Dantu, Southern Donghai; Nan Xuzhou Inspector the Prince of Guiyang, Liu Xiufan, presented it.

translations.literal: On the yimao day of the fifth month of the third year of Taishi, a white roe deer appeared in Duchang, Beihai; Qingzhou Inspector Shen Wenxiu presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the fifth month in the third year of Taishi, a white roe deer appeared in Duchang, Beihai; Qingzhou Inspector Shen Wenxiu presented it.

sentences.zh: 泰始五年正月癸卯，白麞見汝陰樓煩，豫州刺史劉勔以獻。

translations.literal: On the guimao day of the first month of the fifth year of Taishi, a white roe deer appeared in Loufan, Ruyin; Yanzhou Inspector Liu Le presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the first month in the fifth year of Taishi, a white roe deer appeared in Loufan, Ruyin; Yanzhou Inspector Liu Le presented it.

translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day of the tenth month in the first year of Taiyu, a white roe deer appeared at Mount Guoshan, Yixing; Administrator Wang Yun presented it.

translations.literal: On the jiawu day of the first month of the first year of Yuanhui of the Deposed Emperor, a white roe deer appeared at Ninghai, Hailing; Hailing Administrator Sun Sizhi presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the first month in the first year of Yuanhui, a white roe deer appeared at Ninghai, Hailing; Hailing Administrator Sun Sizhi presented it.

sentences.zh: 文帝元嘉二十三年五月甲寅，東宮隊白從陳超獲黑麞於肥如縣，皇太子以獻。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day of the fifth month of the twenty-third year of Yuanjia of Emperor Wen, Chen Chao, a personal attendant in the Eastern Palace's white guard, captured a black roe deer at Feiru County; the Crown Prince presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the fifth month in the twenty-third year of Yuanjia, Chen Chao, a personal attendant in the Eastern Palace guard, captured a black roe deer at Feiru County; the Crown Prince presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十三年十月辛巳，東宮將魏榮獲青麞於秣陵。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day of the tenth month of the twenty-third year of Yuanjia, General Wei Rong of the Eastern Palace captured a bluish roe deer at Moling.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the tenth month in the twenty-third year of Yuanjia, Eastern Palace General Wei Rong captured a bluish roe deer at Moling.

sentences.zh: 元嘉十年十二月，營城縣民成公會之於廣陵高郵界獲白麞麂以獻。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the tenth year of Yuanjia, the commoner Cheng Gong of Yingcheng County captured a white roe deer and a white muntjac at the Gaoyou border in Guangling and presented them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the tenth year of Yuanjia, Cheng Gong, a commoner of Yingcheng County, captured a white roe deer and a white muntjac on the Gaoyou border in Guangling and presented them.

sentences.zh: 孝武帝大明元年二月己亥，白麂見會稽諸暨縣，獲以獻。

translations.literal: On the jihai day of the second month of the first year of Daming of Emperor Xiaowu, a white muntjac appeared in Zhuji County, Kuaiji; it was captured and presented.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the second month in the first year of Daming, a white muntjac appeared in Zhuji County, Kuaiji; it was captured and presented.

sentences.zh: 銀麂，刑罰得共，民不為非則至。

translations.literal: The silver muntjac — when punishments are balanced and the people do no wrong, it comes.
translations.idiomatic: The silver muntjac appears when punishments are even-handed and the people refrain from wrongdoing.

translations.literal: Lacuna.
translations.idiomatic: The passage is lost in the source.

sentences.zh: 赤兔，王者德盛則至。

translations.literal: The Red Hare — when a king's virtue is flourishing, it comes.
translations.idiomatic: The Red Hare appears when a sovereign's virtue is at its height.

translations.literal: Lacuna.
translations.idiomatic: The passage is lost in the source.

sentences.zh: 比翼鳥，王者德及高遠則至。

translations.literal: The paired-wing bird — when a king's virtue reaches to the heights and distances, it comes.
translations.idiomatic: The paired-wing bird appears when a sovereign's virtue extends to the farthest heights and horizons.

translations.literal: Lacuna.
translations.idiomatic: The passage is lost in the source.

sentences.zh: 赤雀，周文王時銜丹書來至。

translations.literal: The red sparrow — in the time of King Wen of Zhou it came bearing a red writing tablet in its beak.
translations.idiomatic: The red sparrow came in the age of King Wen of Zhou, carrying a red writ in its beak.

sentences.zh: 晉愍帝建興三年四月癸酉，赤雀見平州府舍。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day of the fourth month of the third year of Jianxing of Emperor Min of Jin, a red sparrow appeared at the prefectural seat of Ping Province.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the fourth month in the third year of Jianxing, a red sparrow appeared at the seat of Ping Province.

sentences.zh: 宋文帝元嘉二十年五月，赤雀集南平郡府，內史臧綽以聞。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the twentieth year of Yuanjia of Emperor Wen of Song, red sparrows gathered at the prefectural seat of Nanping Commandery; Interior Administrator Zang Chuo reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twentieth year of Yuanjia, red sparrows gathered at the seat of Nanping Commandery; Interior Administrator Zang Chuo reported it.

sentences.zh: 孝武帝孝建元年五月己亥，臨沂縣魯尚斯軍人於城上獲赤雀，太傅假黃鉞江夏王義恭以獻。

translations.literal: On the jihai day of the fifth month of the first year of Xiaojian of Emperor Xiaowu, soldier Lu Shangsi of Linyi County captured a red sparrow on the city wall; the Grand Tutor holding the yellow axe, the Prince of Jiangxia Liu Yigong, presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the fifth month in the first year of Xiaojian, Lu Shangsi, a soldier of Linyi County, captured a red sparrow on the city wall; Grand Tutor and bearer of the yellow axe, the Prince of Jiangxia Liu Yigong, presented it.

sentences.zh: 福草者，宗廟肅，則生宗廟之中。

translations.literal: As for the fortune-grass, when the ancestral temple is solemn, it grows within the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: Fortune-grass grows within the ancestral temple when the rites of the ancestral shrine are conducted with due solemnity.

translations.literal: Lacuna.
translations.idiomatic: The passage is lost in the source.

sentences.zh: 蒼烏者，賢君修行孝慈於萬姓，不好殺生則來。

translations.literal: As for the azure bird, when a worthy ruler practices filial piety and compassion toward the myriad people and does not delight in killing, it comes.
translations.idiomatic: The azure bird appears when a worthy sovereign practices filial piety and compassion for the people and takes no pleasure in slaughter.

sentences.zh: 宋孝武帝大明元年五月丁丑，蒼烏見襄陽縣。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day of the fifth month of the first year of Daming of Emperor Xiaowu of Song, an azure bird appeared in Xiangyang County.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the fifth month in the first year of Daming, an azure bird appeared in Xiangyang County.

sentences.zh: 大明二年四月甲申，蒼烏見襄陽，雍州刺史王玄謨以獻。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day of the fourth month of the second year of Daming, an azure bird appeared in Xiangyang; Yongzhou Inspector Wang Xuanmo presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the fourth month in the second year of Daming, an azure bird appeared in Xiangyang; Yongzhou Inspector Wang Xuanmo presented it.

sentences.zh: 甘露，王者德至大，和氣盛，則降。

translations.literal: Sweet dew — when a king's virtue reaches its greatest extent and harmonious qi is abundant, it descends.
translations.idiomatic: Sweet dew descends when a sovereign's virtue is at its fullest and harmonious qi fills the realm.

sentences.zh: 栢受甘露，王者耆老見敬，則栢受甘露。

translations.literal: When cypress receives sweet dew: when an aged king is shown respect, the cypress receives sweet dew.
translations.idiomatic: Cypress trees receive sweet dew when a sovereign in his old age is treated with due reverence.

sentences.zh: 竹受甘露，王者尊賢愛老，不失細微，則竹葦受甘露。

translations.literal: When bamboo receives sweet dew: when a king honors the worthy and cherishes the aged without neglecting small things, then bamboo and reeds receive sweet dew.
translations.idiomatic: Bamboo and reeds receive sweet dew when a sovereign honors the worthy, cares for the aged, and does not overlook the least detail.

sentences.zh: 漢宣帝元康元年三月，甘露降未央宮。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Yuankang of Emperor Xuan of Han, sweet dew descended in Weiyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the first year of Yuankang, sweet dew descended in Weiyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 漢宣帝神雀二年二月，甘露降京師。

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year of Shenque of Emperor Xuan of Han, sweet dew descended in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the second year of Shenque, sweet dew descended in the capital.

sentences.zh: 神雀四年春，甘露降京師。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year of Shenque, sweet dew descended in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year of Shenque, sweet dew descended in the capital.

sentences.zh: 漢宣帝五鳳二年正月，甘露降京師。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year of Wufeng of Emperor Xuan of Han, sweet dew descended in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year of Wufeng, sweet dew descended in the capital.

sentences.zh: 漢成帝元延四年三月，甘露降京師。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year of Yuanyan of Emperor Cheng of Han, sweet dew descended in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fourth year of Yuanyan, sweet dew descended in the capital.

sentences.zh: 漢光武建武中元元年五月，郡國上甘露降。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Zhongyuan of Jianwu of Emperor Guangwu of Han, commanderies and kingdoms reported sweet dew descending.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of Zhongyuan in the Jianwu era, commanderies and kingdoms reported sweet dew descending.

sentences.zh: 漢明帝永平十七年正月戊子夜，帝夢見光武帝、光烈皇后，夢中喜覺，悲不能寐。

translations.literal: On the night of the wuzi day of the first month of the seventeenth year of Yongping of Emperor Ming of Han, the emperor dreamed he saw Emperor Guangwu and Empress Guanglie; waking from the dream in joy, he could not sleep for grief.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the wuzi day in the first month of the seventeenth year of Yongping, Emperor Ming dreamed of Emperor Guangwu and Empress Guanglie; he woke from the dream in joy but could not sleep for grief.

sentences.zh: 明旦上陵，百官、胡客悉會。

translations.literal: At dawn he went to the imperial tombs; the hundred officials and foreign guests all assembled.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn he went to the imperial tombs, and the hundred officials and foreign guests all gathered.

sentences.zh: 太常丞上言，其日陵樹葉有甘露，帝令百官采甘露。

translations.literal: The Vice Director of the Chamberlain for Ceremonials memorialized that on that day the tomb trees' leaves bore sweet dew; the emperor ordered the hundred officials to gather the sweet dew.
translations.idiomatic: The Vice Director of Ceremonials reported that sweet dew had formed on the leaves of the tomb trees that day; the emperor ordered the hundred officials to collect it.

sentences.zh: 帝自伏御牀，視太后莊器奩中物，流涕，敕易奩中脂澤之具。

translations.literal: The emperor himself leaned over the imperial couch, looked at the items in the Empress Dowager's burial casket and cosmetic box, wept, and ordered the cosmetic items in the box replaced.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor himself leaned over the imperial couch, gazed at the Empress Dowager's burial vessels and the contents of her cosmetic box, wept, and ordered the cosmetics within the box renewed.

sentences.zh: 永平十七年春，甘露仍降京師。

translations.literal: In the spring of the seventeenth year of Yongping, sweet dew again descended in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the seventeenth year of Yongping, sweet dew again descended in the capital.

sentences.zh: 漢章帝元和中，甘露降郡國。

translations.literal: In the Yuanhe period of Emperor Zhang of Han, sweet dew descended in commanderies and kingdoms.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yuanhe era of Emperor Zhang, sweet dew descended across the commanderies and kingdoms.

sentences.zh: 漢安帝延光三年四月丙戌，甘露下沛國豐。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day of the fourth month of the third year of Yanguang of Emperor An of Han, sweet dew fell in Feng, Pei State.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day of the fourth month in the third year of Yanguang, sweet dew fell in Feng, Pei State.

sentences.zh: 延光三年七月，甘露下左馮翊頻陽。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year of Yanguang, sweet dew fell in Pinyang, Left Fengyi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year of Yanguang, sweet dew fell in Pinyang, Left Fengyi.

sentences.zh: 漢桓帝延熹三年四月，甘露降上郡。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year of Yanxi of Emperor Huan of Han, sweet dew descended in Shang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year of Yanxi, sweet dew descended in Shang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 漢桓帝永康元年八月，甘露降巴郡。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Yongkang of Emperor Huan of Han, sweet dew descended in Ba Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of Yongkang, sweet dew descended in Ba Commandery.

sentences.zh: 魏文帝初，郡國三十七言甘露降。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Emperor Wen of Wei, thirty-seven commanderies and kingdoms reported sweet dew descending.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Emperor Wen of Wei's reign, thirty-seven commanderies and kingdoms reported sweet dew descending.

sentences.zh: 魏少帝甘露元年五月，鄴及上洛並言甘露降。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Ganlu of the Wei Deposed Emperor, Ye and Shangluo both reported sweet dew descending.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of Ganlu, Ye and Shangluo both reported sweet dew descending.

sentences.zh: 魏元帝咸熙二年四月，南深澤縣言甘露降。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year of Xixi of Emperor Yuan of Wei, Nan Shenze County reported sweet dew descending.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year of Xixi, Nan Shenze County reported sweet dew descending.

sentences.zh: 吳孫權黃武前，建業言甘露降。

translations.literal: Before the Huangwu reign of Sun Quan of Wu, Jianye reported sweet dew descending.
translations.idiomatic: Before the Huangwu era of Sun Quan of Wu, Jianye reported sweet dew descending.

sentences.zh: 黃武二年五月，曲阿言甘露降。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year of Huangwu, Qu'a reported sweet dew descending.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year of Huangwu, Qu'a reported sweet dew descending.

sentences.zh: 吳孫權嘉禾五年三月，武昌言甘露降於禮賓殿。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fifth year of Jiahe of Sun Quan of Wu, Wuchang reported sweet dew descending in the Hall of Ceremonial Reception.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fifth year of Jiahe, Wuchang reported sweet dew descending in the Hall of Ceremonial Reception.

sentences.zh: 吳孫權赤烏二年三月，零陵言甘露降。

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year of Chiwu of Sun Quan of Wu, Lingling reported sweet dew descending.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year of Chiwu, Lingling reported sweet dew descending.

sentences.zh: 赤烏九年四月，武昌言甘露降。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the ninth year of Chiwu, Wuchang reported sweet dew descending.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the ninth year of Chiwu, Wuchang reported sweet dew descending.

sentences.zh: 吳孫晧甘露元年四月，蔣陵言甘露降。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Ganlu of Sun Hao of Wu, Jiangling reported sweet dew descending.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of Ganlu, Jiangling reported sweet dew descending.

sentences.zh: 晉武帝泰始十年四月乙亥，甘露降西河離石。

translations.literal: On the yihai day of the fourth month of the tenth year of Taishi of Emperor Wu of Jin, sweet dew descended in Lishi, Xihe.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day of the fourth month in the tenth year of Taishi, sweet dew descended in Lishi, Xihe.

sentences.zh: 晉武帝咸寧元年四月丙戌，甘露降張掖。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day of the fourth month of the first year of Xianning of Emperor Wu of Jin, sweet dew descended in Zhangye.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day of the fourth month in the first year of Xianning, sweet dew descended in Zhangye.

sentences.zh: 咸寧元年五月戊午，甘露降清河繹幕。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day of the fifth month of the first year of Xianning, sweet dew descended in Yimu, Qinghe.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the fifth month in the first year of Xianning, sweet dew descended in Yimu, Qinghe.

sentences.zh: 咸寧元年九月，甘露降太原晉陽。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the first year of Xianning, sweet dew descended in Jinyang, Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the first year of Xianning, sweet dew descended in Jinyang, Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 咸寧二年五月戊子，甘露降玄菟郡治。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day of the fifth month of the second year of Xianning, sweet dew descended at the seat of Xuantu Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the fifth month in the second year of Xianning, sweet dew descended at the seat of Xuantu Commandery.

sentences.zh: 咸寧五年六月戊申，甘露降巴郡南充國。

translations.literal: On the wushen day of the sixth month of the fifth year of Xianning, sweet dew descended in Nanchong Kingdom, Ba Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the sixth month in the fifth year of Xianning, sweet dew descended in Nanchong Kingdom, Ba Commandery.

sentences.zh: 晉武帝太康五年三月乙卯，甘露降東宮。

translations.literal: On the yimao day of the third month of the fifth year of Taikang of Emperor Wu of Jin, sweet dew descended in the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the third month in the fifth year of Taikang, sweet dew descended in the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 太康七年四月，甘露降京兆杜陵。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the seventh year of Taikang, sweet dew descended at Duling in Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the seventh year of Taikang, sweet dew descended at Duling in Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 太康七年五月，甘露降魏郡鄴。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the seventh year of Taikang, sweet dew descended at Ye in Wei Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the seventh year of Taikang, sweet dew descended at Ye in Wei Commandery.

sentences.zh: 晉惠帝元康四年五月，甘露降樂陵郡。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fourth year of Yuankang of Emperor Hui of Jin, sweet dew descended in Leiling Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fourth year of Yuankang, sweet dew descended in Leiling Commandery.

sentences.zh: 晉愍帝建興元年六月，甘露降西平縣。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Jianxing of Emperor Min of Jin, sweet dew descended in Xiping County.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of Jianxing, sweet dew descended in Xiping County.

sentences.zh: 建興三年八月己未，甘露降新昌縣。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day of the eighth month of the third year of Jianxing, sweet dew descended in Xinchang County.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the eighth month in the third year of Jianxing, sweet dew descended in Xinchang County.

sentences.zh: 晉愍帝建武元年六月丁丑，甘露降壽春。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day of the sixth month of the first year of Jianwu of Emperor Min of Jin, sweet dew descended in Shouchun.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the sixth month in the first year of Jianwu, sweet dew descended in Shouchun.

sentences.zh: 晉元帝太興三年四月，甘露降琅邪費。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year of Taixing of Emperor Yuan of Jin, sweet dew descended in Fei, Langya.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year of Taixing, sweet dew descended in Fei, Langya.

sentences.zh: 晉明帝太寧二年正月，巴郡言甘露降。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year of Taining of Emperor Ming of Jin, Ba Commandery reported sweet dew descending.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year of Taining, Ba Commandery reported sweet dew descending.

sentences.zh: 晉成帝咸和四年四月，甘露降武昌郡閤前柳樹，太守詡以聞。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourth year of Xianhe of Emperor Cheng of Jin, sweet dew descended on the willow before the gate of Wuchang Commandery; Administrator Xu reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourth year of Xianhe, sweet dew descended on the willow before the gate of Wuchang Commandery; Administrator Xu reported it.

sentences.zh: 咸和六年三月，甘露降寧州城內北園榛桃樹，刺史以聞。

translations.literal: In the third month of the sixth year of Xianhe, sweet dew descended on the hazelnut and peach trees in the northern garden within Ning Province city; the inspector reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the sixth year of Xianhe, sweet dew descended on the hazel and peach trees in the northern garden within the city of Ning Province; the inspector reported it.

sentences.zh: 咸和七年四月癸巳，甘露降京邑，揚州刺史王導以聞。

translations.literal: On the guisi day of the fourth month of the seventh year of Xianhe, sweet dew descended in the capital; Yangzhou Inspector Wang Dao reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day of the fourth month in the seventh year of Xianhe, sweet dew descended in the capital; Yangzhou Inspector Wang Dao reported it.

sentences.zh: 咸和八年四月癸卯，甘露降廬江襄安縣蔣冑家。

translations.literal: On the guimao day of the fourth month of the eighth year of Xianhe, sweet dew descended at the home of Jiang Zhou in Xiang'an County, Lujiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the fourth month in the eighth year of Xianhe, sweet dew descended at the home of Jiang Zhou in Xiang'an County, Lujiang.

sentences.zh: 咸和八年四月癸卯，甘露降宣城宛陵縣之須里。

translations.literal: On the guimao day of the fourth month of the eighth year of Xianhe, sweet dew descended in Xuli, Wanling County, Xuancheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the fourth month in the eighth year of Xianhe, sweet dew descended in Xuli, Wanling County, Xuancheng.

sentences.zh: 咸和九年四月甲寅，甘露降吳國錢唐縣右鄉康巷之柳樹。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day of the fourth month of the ninth year of Xianhe, sweet dew descended on the willow at Kang Lane in Youxiang, Qiantang County, Wu Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the fourth month in the ninth year of Xianhe, sweet dew descended on the willow at Kang Lane in Youxiang, Qiantang County, Wu Commandery.

sentences.zh: 咸和九年十二月丙辰，甘露降建平陵。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day of the twelfth month of the ninth year of Xianhe, sweet dew descended at Jianping Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the twelfth month in the ninth year of Xianhe, sweet dew descended at Jianping Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 咸和九年十二月丁巳，甘露降武平陵。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day of the twelfth month of the ninth year of Xianhe, sweet dew descended at Wuping Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the twelfth month in the ninth year of Xianhe, sweet dew descended at Wuping Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 晉成帝咸康元年四月癸卯，甘露降西堂桃樹。

translations.literal: On the guimao day of the fourth month of the first year of Xiankang of Emperor Cheng of Jin, sweet dew descended on the peach trees at the Western Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the fourth month in the first year of Xiankang, sweet dew descended on the peach trees at the Western Hall.

sentences.zh: 咸康二年三月甲戌，甘露降鬱林城內。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day of the third month of the second year of Xiankang, sweet dew descended within Yulin city.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the third month in the second year of Xiankang, sweet dew descended within Yulin city.

sentences.zh: 咸康二年四月，甘露降西堂，又降尚書都坐桃樹，又降會稽永興縣，眾官畢賀。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year of Xiankang, sweet dew descended at the Western Hall, again descended on the peach tree at the Minister of Works' seat, again descended in Yongxing County, Kuaiji — all officials congratulated.

translations.literal: From the twenty-third to the twenty-fourth year of Yuanjia through the twelfth month, sweet dew repeatedly descended, shaped like fine snow; the capital and commanderies and kingdoms everywhere were the same — beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: From the twenty-third through the twenty-fourth year of Yuanjia until the twelfth month, sweet dew repeatedly descended, shaped like fine snow; the capital and commanderies and kingdoms everywhere were alike — beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十五年十一月庚辰，甘露降南郡，荊州刺史南譙王義宣以聞。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day of the eleventh month of the twenty-fifth year of Yuanjia, sweet dew descended in Nan Commandery; Jingzhou Inspector Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day of the eleventh month in the twenty-fifth year of Yuanjia, sweet dew descended in Nan Commandery; Jingzhou Inspector Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十五年十一月乙未，甘露降丹陽秣陵巖山。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day of the eleventh month of the twenty-fifth year of Yuanjia, sweet dew descended on Mount Yan, Moling, Danyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day of the eleventh month in the twenty-fifth year of Yuanjia, sweet dew descended on Mount Yan, Moling, Danyang.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十六年三月壬午，甘露降景陽山，華林園丞梅道念以聞。

translations.literal: On the renwu day of the third month of the twenty-sixth year of Yuanjia, sweet dew descended on Jingyang Mountain; Hualin Garden Director Mei Daonian reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the third month in the twenty-sixth year of Yuanjia, sweet dew descended on Jingyang Mountain; Hualin Garden Director Mei Daonian reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十六年三月庚寅、癸巳，甘露頻降武昌，江州刺史廬陵王紹以聞。

translations.literal: On the gengyin and guisi days of the third month of the twenty-sixth year of Yuanjia, sweet dew repeatedly descended in Wuchang; Jiangzhou Inspector Prince of Luling Shao reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin and guisi days of the third month in the twenty-sixth year of Yuanjia, sweet dew repeatedly descended in Wuchang; Jiangzhou Inspector Prince of Luling Shao reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十六年四月甲辰、丙午、戊申，甘露頻降豫章南昌，太守劉思考以聞。

translations.literal: On the jiachen, bingwu, and wushen days of the fourth month of the twenty-sixth year of Yuanjia, sweet dew repeatedly descended in Nanchang, Yuzhang; Administrator Liu Sikao reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen, bingwu, and wushen days of the fourth month in the twenty-sixth year of Yuanjia, sweet dew repeatedly descended in Nanchang, Yuzhang; Administrator Liu Sikao reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十六年七月，甘露降南郡江陵，荊州刺史南譙王義宣以聞。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the twenty-sixth year of Yuanjia, sweet dew descended in Jiangling, Nan Commandery; Jingzhou Inspector Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the twenty-sixth year of Yuanjia, sweet dew descended in Jiangling, Nan Commandery; Jingzhou Inspector Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十七年四月乙卯、丙辰、丁巳，甘露頻降豫章南昌。

translations.literal: On the yimao, bingchen, and dingsi days of the fourth month of the twenty-seventh year of Yuanjia, sweet dew repeatedly descended in Nanchang, Yuzhang.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao, bingchen, and dingsi days of the fourth month in the twenty-seventh year of Yuanjia, sweet dew repeatedly descended in Nanchang, Yuzhang.

sentences.zh: 戊午午時，天氣清明，有綵霧映覆郡邑，甘露又自雲降。

translations.literal: At the wuwu hour of the wuwu day, the weather was clear; colored mist enveloped the commandery seat, and sweet dew again descended from the clouds.
translations.idiomatic: At the wuwu hour on the wuwu day, the weather was clear; colored mist enveloped the commandery seat, and sweet dew again descended from the clouds.

sentences.zh: 太守劉思考以聞。

translations.literal: Administrator Liu Sikao reported it.
translations.idiomatic: Administrator Liu Sikao reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十七年五月甲戌，甘露降東海丹徒，南徐州刺史始興王濬以聞。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day of the fifth month of the twenty-seventh year of Yuanjia, sweet dew descended in Dantu, Donghai; Southern Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Shixing Jun reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the fifth month in the twenty-seventh year of Yuanjia, sweet dew descended in Dantu, Donghai; Southern Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Shixing Jun reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十八年二月戊辰，甘露降鍾山延賢寺，揚州刺史廬陵王紹以聞。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day of the second month of the twenty-eighth year of Yuanjia, sweet dew descended at Yanxian Temple on Zhong Mountain; Yangzhou Inspector Prince of Luling Shao reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the second month in the twenty-eighth year of Yuanjia, sweet dew descended at Yanxian Temple on Zhong Mountain; Yangzhou Inspector Prince of Luling Shao reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十八年二月壬午，甘露降徽音殿前果樹。

translations.literal: On the renwu day of the second month of the twenty-eighth year of Yuanjia, sweet dew descended on the fruit trees before Huiyin Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the second month in the twenty-eighth year of Yuanjia, sweet dew descended on the fruit trees before Huiyin Hall.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十八年二月，甘露降合歡殿後香花諸草。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-eighth year of Yuanjia, sweet dew descended on the fragrant flowers and various grasses behind Hehuan Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twenty-eighth year of Yuanjia, sweet dew descended on the fragrant flowers and various grasses behind Hehuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 孝武帝孝建元年三月丙辰，甘露降華林園。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day of the third month of the first year of Xiaojian of Emperor Xiaowu, sweet dew descended in Hualin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the third month in the first year of Xiaojian, sweet dew descended in Hualin Garden.

sentences.zh: 孝建二年三月己酉，甘露降丹陽秣陵中里路與之墓樹。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day of the third month of the second year of Xiaojian, sweet dew descended on the trees at Lu Yuzhi's tomb in Zhongli, Moling, Danyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the third month in the second year of Xiaojian, sweet dew descended on the trees at Lu Yuzhi's tomb in Zhongli, Moling, Danyang.

sentences.zh: 孝建二年三月辛亥，甘露降長寧陵松樹。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day of the third month of the second year of Xiaojian, sweet dew descended on the pine trees at Changning Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the third month in the second year of Xiaojian, sweet dew descended on the pine trees at Changning Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 孝建二年三月，甘露降襄陽民家梨樹。

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year of Xiaojian, sweet dew descended on pear trees at a commoner's home in Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year of Xiaojian, sweet dew descended on pear trees at a commoner's home in Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 孝建二年三月戊午，甘露降丹陽秣陵尚書謝莊園竹林，莊以聞。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day of the third month of the second year of Xiaojian, sweet dew descended on the bamboo grove in the garden of Minister of Works Xie Zhuang, Moling, Danyang; Zhuang reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the third month in the second year of Xiaojian, sweet dew descended on the bamboo grove in the garden of Minister of Works Xie Zhuang, Moling, Danyang; Zhuang reported it.

sentences.zh: 孝武帝大明元年四月癸卯，甘露降華林園桐樹。

translations.literal: On the guimao day of the fourth month of the first year of Daming of Emperor Xiaowu, sweet dew descended on the paulownia trees in Hualin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the fourth month in the first year of Daming, sweet dew descended on the paulownia trees in Hualin Garden.

sentences.zh: 大明三年三月己卯，甘露降樂游苑梅樹。

translations.literal: On the jimao day of the third month of the third year of Daming, sweet dew descended on the plum trees in Leyou Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day of the third month in the third year of Daming, sweet dew descended on the plum trees in Leyou Garden.

sentences.zh: 大明三年三月戊子，甘露降宣城郡舍，太守張辯以聞。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day of the third month of the third year of Daming, sweet dew descended at the Xuancheng Commandery headquarters; Administrator Zhang Bian reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the third month in the third year of Daming, sweet dew descended at the Xuancheng Commandery headquarters; Administrator Zhang Bian reported it.

sentences.zh: 大明四年正月壬辰，甘露降初寧陵松樹。

translations.literal: On the renchen day of the first month of the fourth year of Daming, sweet dew descended on the pine trees at Chuning Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day of the first month in the fourth year of Daming, sweet dew descended on the pine trees at Chuning Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 大明四年二月丙申，甘露降長寧陵松樹。

translations.literal: On the bingshen day of the second month of the fourth year of Daming, sweet dew descended on the pine trees at Changning Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the second month in the fourth year of Daming, sweet dew descended on the pine trees at Changning Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 大明四年二月乙巳，甘露降丹陽秣陵龍山，丹陽尹孔靈符以聞。

translations.literal: On the yisi day of the second month of the fourth year of Daming, sweet dew descended on Long Mountain, Moling, Danyang; Danyang Magistrate Kong Lingfu reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day of the second month in the fourth year of Daming, sweet dew descended on Long Mountain, Moling, Danyang; Danyang Magistrate Kong Lingfu reported it.

sentences.zh: 大明五年四月辛亥，甘露降吳興安吉，太守歷陽王子頊以聞。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day of the fourth month of the fifth year of Daming, sweet dew descended in Anji, Wuxing; Administrator Prince of Liyang Ziyu reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the fourth month in the fifth year of Daming, sweet dew descended in Anji, Wuxing; Administrator Prince of Liyang Ziyu reported it.

sentences.zh: 大明五年四月乙卯，甘露降吳興烏程，太守歷陽王子頊以聞。

translations.literal: On the yimao day of the fourth month of the fifth year of Daming, sweet dew descended in Wucheng, Wuxing; Administrator Prince of Liyang Ziyu reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the fourth month in the fifth year of Daming, sweet dew descended in Wucheng, Wuxing; Administrator Prince of Liyang Ziyu reported it.

sentences.zh: 大明六年二月戊午，甘露降建康靈燿寺及諸苑園，及秣陵龍山，至于婁湖。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day of the second month of the sixth year of Daming, sweet dew descended at Lingyao Temple in Jiankang and the various gardens and parks, also on Long Mountain, Moling, reaching as far as Lou Lake.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the second month in the sixth year of Daming, sweet dew descended at Lingyao Temple in Jiankang and the various gardens and parks, on Long Mountain, Moling, and as far as Lou Lake.

sentences.zh: 是日，又降句容、江寧二縣。

translations.literal: That day, sweet dew again descended in Jurong and Jiangning counties.
translations.idiomatic: That day, sweet dew again descended in Jurong and Jiangning counties.

sentences.zh: 大明七年三月丙申，甘露降尋陽松滋，太守劉矇以聞。

translations.literal: On the bingshen day of the third month of the seventh year of Daming, sweet dew descended in Songzi, Xunyang; Administrator Liu Meng reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the third month in the seventh year of Daming, sweet dew descended in Songzi, Xunyang; Administrator Liu Meng reported it.

sentences.zh: 大明七年四月己未，甘露降荊州城內，刺史臨海王子頊以聞。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day of the fourth month of the seventh year of Daming, sweet dew descended within Jing Province city; Inspector Prince of Linhai Ziyu reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the fourth month in the seventh year of Daming, sweet dew descended within Jing Province city; Inspector Prince of Linhai Ziyu reported it.

sentences.zh: 大明七年十二月辛丑朔，甘露降吳興烏程，令苟卞之以聞。

translations.literal: On the first day, xinchou, of the twelfth month of the seventh year of Daming, sweet dew descended in Wucheng, Wuxing; Magistrate Gou Bianzhi reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day, xinchou, of the twelfth month in the seventh year of Daming, sweet dew descended in Wucheng, Wuxing; Magistrate Gou Bianzhi reported it.

sentences.zh: 明帝泰始二年四月己未，甘露降上林苑，苑令徐承道以獻。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day of the fourth month of the second year of Taishi of Emperor Ming, sweet dew descended in Shanglin Garden; Garden Director Xu Chengdao presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the fourth month in the second year of Taishi, sweet dew descended in Shanglin Garden; Garden Director Xu Chengdao presented it.

sentences.zh: 泰始二年四月庚申，甘露降華林園，園令臧延之以獻。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day of the fourth month of the second year of Taishi, sweet dew descended in Hualin Garden; Garden Director Zang Yanzhi presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the fourth month in the second year of Taishi, sweet dew descended in Hualin Garden; Garden Director Zang Yanzhi presented it.

sentences.zh: 泰始二年五月己亥，甘露降丹陽秣陵縣舍齋前竹，丹陽尹王景文以獻。

translations.literal: On the jihai day of the fifth month of the second year of Taishi, sweet dew descended on the bamboo before the fasting hall at the Moling County headquarters, Danyang; Danyang Magistrate Wang Jingwen presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the fifth month in the second year of Taishi, sweet dew descended on the bamboo before the fasting hall at the Moling County headquarters, Danyang; Danyang Magistrate Wang Jingwen presented it.

sentences.zh: 泰始三年十一月庚申，甘露降晉陵，晉陵太守王蘊以聞。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day of the eleventh month of the third year of Taishi, sweet dew descended in Jinling; Jinling Administrator Wang Yun reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the eleventh month in the third year of Taishi, sweet dew descended in Jinling; Jinling Administrator Wang Yun reported it.

sentences.zh: 泰始三年十一月癸亥，甘露降南東海丹徒建岡，徐州刺史桂陽王休範以聞。

translations.literal: On the day guihai of the eleventh month of the third year of the Taishi reign, sweet dew descended at Jiangang in Dantu, Southern Donghai; the Inspector of Xu Province, the Prince of Guiyang Xiufan, reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the eleventh month in the third year of Taishi, sweet dew fell at Jiangang in Dantu, Southern Donghai, and Xiufan, Prince of Guiyang and inspector of Xu Province, reported it.

sentences.zh: 泰始三年十二月壬午，甘露降崇寧陵，揚州刺史建安王休仁以聞。

translations.literal: On the day renwu of the twelfth month of the third year of Taishi, sweet dew descended at Chongning Mausoleum; the Inspector of Yang Province, the Prince of Jian'an Xiuren, reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the twelfth month in the third year of Taishi, sweet dew fell at Chongning Mausoleum, and Xiuren, Prince of Jian'an and inspector of Yang Province, reported it.

sentences.zh: 後廢帝元徽四年十一月乙巳，甘露降吳興烏程，太守蕭惠明以聞。

translations.literal: On the day yisi of the eleventh month of the fourth year of the Yuanhui reign of the Deposed Emperor, sweet dew descended at Wucheng in Wuxing; Grand Administrator Xiao Huiming reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day of the eleventh month in the fourth year of Yuanhui under the Deposed Emperor, sweet dew fell at Wucheng in Wuxing, and Grand Administrator Xiao Huiming reported it.

sentences.zh: 順帝昇明二年十二月，甘露降建康禁中里。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the second year of the Shengming reign of Emperor Shun, sweet dew descended in Jinli within the forbidden precinct of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the second year of Shengming, Emperor Shun, sweet dew fell in Jinli within the palace quarter at Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 昇明二年十一月，甘露降南東海武進彭山，太守謝朏以聞。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the second year of Shengming, sweet dew descended at Pengshan in Wujin, Southern Donghai; Grand Administrator Xie Tiao reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the second year of Shengming, sweet dew fell at Pengshan in Wujin, Southern Donghai, and Grand Administrator Xie Tiao reported it.

sentences.zh: 昇明二年十一月，甘露降吳興長城卞山，太守王奐以聞。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the second year of Shengming, sweet dew descended at Bianshan in Changcheng, Wuxing; Grand Administrator Wang Huan reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the second year of Shengming, sweet dew fell at Bianshan in Changcheng, Wuxing, and Grand Administrator Wang Huan reported it.

sentences.zh: 威香者，王者禮備則常生。

translations.literal: Awesome fragrance — when a king's ritual is complete, it constantly grows.
translations.idiomatic: Awesome fragrance appears when a sovereign's rites are fully in order and then grows without fail.
